[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/h-cabinet.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-chamber.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"Democracy is too expensive. We found a more efficient model." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF][i]Harrison Blackstone[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i], 2028[/i][/color]

[color=white]Since the bankruptcy of the Republic in 2028, the Free States of Los Vales have been governed by the [/color][color=white][b]Corporate Cabinet[/b][/color][color=white]: a council of the largest corporations in the country, controlled by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white]. It had twenty seats in 2028; since the [/color][color=white][b]Great Mergers[/b][/color][color=white] (2050–2079) it has ten conglomerates. The Cabinet writes the laws, approves the budget, signs every public contract, grants the charters of the seven cities — and chooses the president.[/color]

[color=white]Nobody is elected to the Cabinet. A seat is bought. To keep one, a corporation must pay the annual [/color][color=white][b]Seat Fee[/b][/color][color=white] and hold a minimum share of the national debt bonds. Votes are not equal: each seat has as many votes as its owner's weight in the economy. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] and the Blackstone Group have six each. Three seats are chaired by the dead — the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF]Eterna[/color][/url][color=white] AIs of Soren Vale, General Kruger and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF]Marlon Price[/color][/url][color=white]. Any law needs 22 of the 42 votes. Sessions are closed, minutes are secret, and the Cabinet meets in the Cabinet Tower, in the center of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white], a few blocks from Zyx's headquarters.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-seats.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/h-president.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-president.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The president of the Free States is not elected. The Cabinet appoints one by simple majority, and the president stays in office until the Cabinet decides otherwise. There is no fixed term — some presidents lasted twelve years, others three. Since 2028, every president has been a former executive of a corporation with a seat.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-president-powers.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/h-elections.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-election.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The only elections left in Los Vales are for the mayors of the seven cities. Each city votes every seven years, and the cities take turns: one election a year, every year, in a fixed order. Every citizen of the city has one vote — and, since the deregulation of 2038, the right to sell it. Vote credits are traded openly in the weeks before election day.[/color]

[color=white]There is a catch: every candidate must be approved by the Cabinet and sponsored by a corporation with a seat. In practice, each city elects the corporation that already owns it. Mayors manage local contracts, permits and the city police — which, like everything else, is private.[/color]

[color=white]Why keep elections at all? Because the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white] and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832733][color=#7FDBFF]Southern Market[/color][/url][color=white] trade only with countries that have an elected government, and seven mayors are enough to call it one. And because election week is the only week of the year when the rich pay the poor.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-elections-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/h-debt.png[/img][/background][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]In 2028 the Republic of Los Vales went bankrupt, owing billions to the megacorporations — above all to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white]. The Free States did not erase that debt: they inherited it. Under the [/color][color=white][b]Debt Accord of 2028[/b][/color][color=white], signed by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Helena Vasquez[/color][/url][color=white] on her last day in office, every service the State still runs must charge for itself, and part of every payment goes straight to the Meridian Trust until the national debt is paid.[/color]

[color=white]That is the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF][b]Debt Fee[/b][/color][/url][color=white], and it is printed on every public bill in the country. The debt has never shrunk: the interest grows faster than the fees. Sixty years later, Valians still pay for a bankruptcy most of them were not alive to see — and the few services the State never sold are the ones nobody wanted to buy.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"The State does not give you anything. It rents it to you, to pay for what it lost." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF][i]Neon Wire[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i] broadcast, 2085[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/h-services.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-services.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-police.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]There is no national police in Los Vales. Each city signs a contract with a security corporation, and each district pays for its own coverage. In the corporate centers, an agent arrives in two minutes; in the outskirts, it is cheaper to call a gang. Subscribers have a priority line. Non-subscribers have a form.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-anchor.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white] is the only armed force that belongs to the State, and the only one the president can command. Its agents hunt [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalkers[/color][/url][color=white] in every city, wear heavy armor, take [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Ancorine[/color][/url][color=white] every day and are the only ones authorized to shoot a dreamwalker in the street. Because it is public, it charges the Debt Fee: when the Anchor takes someone away, the family receives the bill for the operation.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/h-defense.png[/img][/background][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Los Vales has no army. Article VIII of the [/color][color=white][b]Charter[/b][/color][color=white] gives defense to licensed corporations, and since the [/color][color=white][b]Defense Contract of 2029[/b][/color][color=white] the Cabinet rents it: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] provides the soldiers, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] the machines and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white] the weapons; since 2045, Bastion and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cerberus[/color][/url][color=white] guard the networks. The President signs the contracts but commands none of them. In a war, the soldiers obey whoever pays — and the Cabinet always pays on time.[/color]

[color=white]This is how Los Vales fought the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF][b]Reunification War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] of 2049 against the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white], and how it has fought every war abroad without ever declaring one: the doctrine the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] calls [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832738][color=#7FDBFF][b]neutral, but for sale[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. The same companies that defend the border sell weapons to the other side of it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-defense.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"Los Vales has the strongest army in the West. It just does not belong to Los Vales." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832708][color=#7FDBFF][i]Hélène Rousseau[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i], European Commissioner[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-sanitation.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Sewage and water treatment are run by Portenova Utilities, and only where Portenova owns the land. The corporate centers have sealed pipes, filtered air and streets washed every night. A few blocks away, the outskirts live with open sewers, contaminated wells and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] water sold by the liter. In the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white], outside the walls of Zyxtopia, fewer than one home in fifteen is connected to anything.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-sanitation-bars.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/cab-fire.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]There are no public firefighters. The fire brigades belong to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Sentinel Mutual[/color][/url][color=white], and they save insured buildings. When a fire starts in a neighborhood, the trucks arrive, check the policy numbers and hose down the buildings that are covered — sometimes while the house next door burns to the ground. Sentinel calls it "protecting what is covered". The streets call it "the Sentinel line".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/cabinet/ad-cab.gif[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"In Los Vales, you are not a citizen. You are a subscriber." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][i]Elias Crane[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF][i]Church of Reality[/i][/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]How do I vote for the Cabinet?[/b][/color][color=white] You don’t. Your employer does.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who chooses the president?[/b][/color][color=white] The ten conglomerates, with their 42 votes.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF][b]the Charter[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] be changed?[/b][/color][color=white] It has been, 311 times. Twenty-two votes are enough.[/color]

[color=white][b]What if I disagree with a decision?[/b][/color][color=white] Book a hearing at the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]Arbitration Courts[/color][/url][color=white]. It costs 300 credits.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-megacorps.png[/img][/background][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"A government can fall. A corporation only changes owners." — unofficial motto of the [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF][i]Corporate League[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]Los Vales was not founded by a people, but by a boardroom. In 2000 the largest corporations of the West created the [/color][color=white][b]Corporate League[/b][/color][color=white] and turned three forgotten states into a country. Since 2028 the nation has been run by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF][b]Corporate Cabinet[/b][/color][/url][color=white], where the megacorps hold seats and votes, and the president is chosen by them. Since the [/color][color=white][b]Great Mergers[/b][/color][color=white] (2050–2079), the seats belong to ten conglomerates; the old brands on this page live on as their divisions.[/color]

[color=white]In Los Vales a company sells more than products. It owns the water you drink, the street you live on, the news you watch, the dreams you have — and, if you do not pay, the cell you sleep in.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-cabinet-seats.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/cabinet-seats.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]In 2028 the Cabinet had twenty seats. Between 2050 and 2079 its corporations merged into ten conglomerates, each one owning a part of a citizen’s life: [/color][color=white][b]Zyx[/b][/color][color=white] (with Cage Studios), the [/color][color=white][b]Blackstone Group[/b][/color][color=white] (Meridian Trust, ArmaTech, Lockwell), [/color][color=white][b]Vale Holdings[/b][/color][color=white] (AquaVale, Sentinel Mutual, Asclepius, Halo Response), [/color][color=white][b]WM-Automa[/b][/color][color=white], [/color][color=white][b]Kizuna[/b][/color][color=white] (with Genesis Bio), [/color][color=white][b]Panoptica[/b][/color][color=white] (with Bastion, Cerberus and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF]Recall Clinic[/color][/url][color=white]), [/color][color=white][b]OmniMart[/b][/color][color=white] (with Harvest Union), [/color][color=white][b]Bubble[/b][/color][color=white] (with the LVN), [/color][color=white][b]Midnight[/b][/color][color=white] (with TOTAL) and [/color][color=white][b]BeDay Astral[/b][/color][color=white]. Portenova lost its seat in 2085. AboveAll has never had one. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833650][color=#7FDBFF]The Great Mergers →[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-rivalry.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/zyx-vs-kizuna.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Zyx says that to escape pain you must leave reality. Kizuna says you must leave the body. One changes the mind with chemistry; the other trades flesh for metal. Each sees the other as the disease: to Zyx, Kizuna mutilates people; to Kizuna, Zyx puts them to sleep. A brain surrounded by enough Kizuna implants no longer reacts to Zyx drugs — and in 2088, after the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white] was announced, that became the most important fact in the country.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-mind-flesh.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-zyx.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Founded by two chemists, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zachary[/b][/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF][b]Xavyer[/b][/color][/url][color=white], who spent twenty years chasing a single question: how can a whole village dream the same dream? The answer was the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF][b]Eferverso[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2023), the first [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] drug, and it made Zyx the richest company in the country. Zyx bought the naming rights of the capital, finances the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white], manufactures the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Ancorine[/color][/url][color=white] its agents depend on, and in 2088 presented the [/color][color=white][b]Dream Vision[/b][/color][color=white] alongside the president. Its CEO is not a person.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Around 300 Psychoactive Reality drugs and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx Experience[/color][/url][color=white] subscriptions, pharmaceuticals, combat stimulants like [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Velocitas[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Neurotox[/color][/url][color=white], the Ancorine every Anchor agent depends on, and — discreetly — synthetic drugs for cartels abroad. It also runs the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]ZyxNet[/color][/url][color=white] and owns the naming rights of the capital.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] No declared army. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zyx Guard[/b][/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A] — about 30,000 agents — protects its labs and its tower in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A]; the old ArmaTech hackers work for it; and the Anchor Squad cannot last a week without its Ancorine. Its real weapon is that half the country is asleep.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2513519][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-zyx.png[/img][/url][/align]

[spoiler=Zyx: the Shared Dream Patent and Project Horizon][color=white]In 2024 Zyx patented every compound of the Xunaya — but the formula only works at scale with the [/color][color=white][b]living flower[/b][/color][color=white], and the last wild fields grow around Koxez-Kaya Nova. That is why Zyx has never stopped trying to buy the Xinko land.[/color]

[color=white]Amora AI is not new. She is [/color][color=white][b]Horizon[/b][/color][color=white], Sphere’s artificial intelligence, whose core was taken before the auction of 2032 and bought in secret with AboveAll money.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/ad-zyx.gif[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-kizuna.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Born as [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF][b]Nakama[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] Vales[/b][/color][color=white], the Japanese giant's local subsidiary, Kizuna broke away in 2018 when [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF][b]Haruka Mori[/b][/color][/url][color=white] refused to turn her factories into war lines. After seeing what the bomb did to the flesh of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white], she preached [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF][b]Detachment[/b][/color][/url][color=white]: the human body is the weak point, and it should be replaced piece by piece until only the machine remains. Almost every Valian wears a pair of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kizuna Lens[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Today, under her daughter [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF][b]Aiko Mori[/b][/color][/url][color=white], Kizuna sells the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kizuna Core[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the implant that makes a mind immune to Zyx.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Kizuna Lens, artificial arms, lungs, hearts and spines, complete [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Converted[/color][/url][color=white] bodies, the Kizuna Core and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]KizunaLink[/color][/url][color=white] network. Through [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Ferrum Bionics[/color][/url][color=white], the heavy implants of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Vigilantes[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The [/color][color=#FF4A4A][b]Bond Guard[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A]: about 25,000 operatives, many of them Converted, plus Ferrum-built exoskeleton units in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A]. Small in number — but the most augmented force in Los Vales, and immune to every Zyx drug.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830621][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-kizuna.png[/img][/url][/align]

[spoiler=Kizuna: what the Core really does][color=white]The Kizuna Core does not make the mind immune to dreams — only to Zyx’s. It is a receiver of the KizunaLink: whoever carries one can be put to sleep, or kept awake, by Kizuna. And TOTAL’s champion Gorgon is an Unplugged core from 2044 inside a Kizuna body.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/ad-kizuna.gif[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-bubble.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Bubble filmed [/color][color=white][i]The Man of Steel[/i][/color][color=white] in virtual reality in 2007 and helped give birth to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white]. It sided with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white] in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Reality War[/color][/url][color=white] and lost — but survived by selling what Zyx could not control: information. Bubble owns the [/color][color=white][b]Bubblepedia[/b][/color][color=white], published the forbidden investigation into the Dream Vision in 2066, and republished it in 2088. It is Zyx's declared enemy.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] The Bubblepedia, news feeds, virtual reality worlds, entertainment and, above all, information: archives, leaks and data that other companies would pay to keep hidden.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Almost none — a few thousand guards. Its defense is what it knows: Bubble holds files that nobody in the Cabinet wants published.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999873][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-bubble.png[/img][/url][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-automa.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Automa has been replacing workers, drivers and soldiers with machines since the 2020s. With the AI cores bought from Sphere, its robots became smarter than ever — and too human: in 2044 an entire line refused to obey, and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF][b]Droid War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] burned Ferox for eighteen months. Automa won with a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]kill code[/color][/url][color=white]. Since then, every robot made in Los Vales leaves the factory with a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]kill switch[/color][/url][color=white]. What happened to the cores of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white], Automa never says. Its founder, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Viktor Hahn[/b][/color][/url][color=white], retired after the war; his son [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Dieter Hahn[/b][/color][/url][color=white] has run the company since 2051.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Industrial and domestic robots, machines that replace workers, drivers and soldiers, security drones, kill-switch systems — and entire robot armies for rent.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The largest machine army in the country: an estimated [/color][color=#FF4A4A][b]2 million[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] combat and security robots, rented to any client who pays. Every one of them has a kill switch — and only Automa holds the codes.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Automa: the key it never threw away][color=white]The kill code of 2044 still works on any part made from the wreckage of the Unplugged — including the arms and spines Ferrum Bionics built for the Vigilantes before Kizuna bought it in 2052. Automa kept the key.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-genesis.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Genesis Bio grows hearts, lungs, skin and whole replacement bodies in glass tanks. The cells have to come from somewhere: Genesis buys organs from Lockwell debtors who can no longer pay in work hours. In Ferox it is said that some factory shifts are worked by people who all have the same face.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Organs, skin and blood grown in tanks, replacement bodies for the rich, and organ-matching for insurance plans. Clone labor, officially, does not exist.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Small: about 6,000 guards for its tank farms in Ferox. In the factories, the rumor is about something else — soldiers grown to order, with the same face.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Genesis Bio: Project Twin][color=white]The workers with the same face are real. Genesis grows them from the DNA of Lockwell debtors who died in the Escaldar camps. The contract says the debtor’s body belongs to the creditor.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-asclepius.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Every Valian has a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF][b]Life Score[/b][/color][/url][color=white], calculated by Asclepius from Panoptica cameras, Kizuna Lens data and shopping history. The score decides the price of your insurance, whether Halo Response comes for you, and how long you wait in a hospital line. Nobody knows the formula. Everybody knows their number. Founded by [/color][color=white][b]Dr. [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Adrian Kell[/b][/color][/url][color=white], it is run today by his daughter, [/color][color=white][b]Dr. [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Nadia Kell[/b][/color][/url][color=white], whose own Life Score is said to be a perfect 1,000.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Health insurance plans, the Life Score of every Valian, and risk reports sold to employers, banks and landlords.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] None of its own. When a client defaults, Asclepius calls Halo Response to stop coming — and Lockwell to start.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-steel-blood.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-wm.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]In 1999 WM wiped out the gangs of Hermosa. In 2013, armed with the forgotten nuclear arsenal of the West, it defeated the American army and won Los Vales its independence — and its former CEO, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF][b]Menphis Polo[/b][/color][/url][color=white], won the only real election in the country's history. In 2022 a stolen warhead exploded on the roof of its headquarters and erased Hermosa. WM was rebuilt as a defense contractor and held the line in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]Reunification War[/color][/url][color=white], but it never again had the monopoly of the bomb. The general who rebuilt it, [/color][color=white][b]Ada Kruger[/b][/color][color=white], died in 2071 — and still gives the orders: WM is the only army in the world commanded by an [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF][b]Eterna[/b][/color][/url][color=white] copy of its dead general.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Private security, defense contracts, armored escorts, military training for other corps and the armor of every Aurelian car.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The largest human army in Los Vales: about [/color][color=#FF4A4A][b]210,000 soldiers[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A], armored divisions, gunships and what is left of the old western arsenal. It lost the nuclear monopoly in 2022 — but nobody has forgotten that it once had it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=WM: whose orders does the general follow?][color=white]General Kruger’s Eterna copy runs on servers owned by the AboveAll Conglomerate. So do the copies of Marlon Price (OmniMart) and Soren Vale (AquaVale). Their 6 votes, plus the 6 of Zyx, give AboveAll 12 of the 22 votes needed for a majority in the Cabinet.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-armatech.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Heir to the old [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Atlantic Ventures[/color][/url][color=white] and to the Blackstone family. Defeated in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]Second Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white], ArmaTech spent years attacking WM from the inside — and in 2022 its hackers caused the explosion that destroyed Hermosa. It never admitted it — but in the Settlement of 2023 it signed half of its defense orders over to WM, and they still pass through WM today. In the Cabinet the two vote together; in the streets their gangs still fight. The same hackers later reappeared working for Zyx in the Reality War. In [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF]World War III[/color][/url][color=white], ArmaTech sold weapons to every side.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Weapons of every class, from smart rifles and drones to missiles, and cyberwarfare services for any client — no questions asked about which side they are on.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] A modest army of about 30,000 mercenaries — and the most feared hacker division in the country: the same people who broke WM from the inside in 2022.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-halo.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Created the week Hermosa evaporated, by WM military doctors left without a job: armored air ambulances, armed teams and treatment by subscription. The rich of the whole country signed up at once. The Halo rule was born that week and never changed — whoever does not pay is not rescued.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Emergency rescue subscriptions — Silver, Gold and Platinum — armored air ambulances, private hospitals and extraction from combat zones.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] About 15,000 armed medics and 900 armored air ambulances. They only shoot to reach a patient. A paying one.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832662][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-halo.png[/img][/url][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/ad-halo.gif[/img][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-concrete-credit.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-portenova.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Founded by former president [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF][b]Manuella Portenova[/b][/color][/url][color=white], who lost at the ballot box to the man with the guns and decided to own the ground instead. Portenova Corp built Ferox with the refugees of Hermosa, built Zyxtopia with Zyx money, and bought, demolished and resold every town that died in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832736][color=#7FDBFF][b]Urban Monopolization[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Today it is run by her grandson, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kobe Portenova III[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — and the family still dreams of rebuilding the real Hermosa. A country living inside its own head does not need cities.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Construction, land, demolition, popular housing, megastructures and the maintenance of entire cities. Almost every building in Ferox and Zyxtopia was built by it.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] About 20,000 security agents guarding its construction sites and its empty land. Since the Urban Monopolization, even its demolition crews are armed.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-meridian.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The Blackstone family bank, heir to the old Atlantic Banking Trust. In 2028 it was the largest creditor of the bankrupt Republic, and it collected the way corporations collect: by taking control. The first president of the Free States, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF][b]Harrison Blackstone[/b][/color][/url][color=white], was a Meridian director.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Loans, sovereign debt, corporate insurance, vaults, and the credit behind almost every company on this page.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] No army: it owns the debt of those who have one. And the Blackstone family that controls it also controls ArmaTech.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Meridian Trust: Clause Zero][color=white]If the national debt is ever paid in full, the Debt Accord of 2028 dissolves the Free States and brings back the Republic, with elections. That is why the interest always grows faster than the Debt Fee.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-omnimart.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]OmniMart sells everything, from NutriCubes to second-hand implants. Its two million workers receive part of their salary in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF][b]OmniCredits[/b][/color][/url][color=white], which are only accepted at OmniMart — so the money never leaves the store, and neither do they. It quietly fights Harvest Union over the price of food. Its founder, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Marlon Price[/b][/color][/url][color=white], died in 2074; the board never found a reason to replace a CEO who never sleeps, so his [/color][color=white][b]Eterna[/b][/color][color=white] copy still signs the payroll.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Everything: food, clothes, implants, furniture, appliances, funerals. It also runs the OmniMart Academy and issues the OmniCredits.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The largest security force by numbers — about 50,000 store guards — and the worst trained. In 2081, facing its own workers, it called WM and Lockwell instead.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-sentinel.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Founded in Hermosa by [/color][color=white][b]Marcus Vale-Holt[/b][/color][color=white] during the crisis of 2009 — and run today by his granddaughter, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Ivy Vale-Holt[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — when banks were falling and people learned they could lose everything overnight. In a country where a Kizuna arm can be torn off in an alley and a car can burn for being parked on the wrong street, Sentinel Mutual became the most profitable promise in Los Vales: whatever you lose, someone pays. Its premiums are calculated by neighborhood, by Life Score and by Panoptica footage — in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white], insuring a car costs more than the car.[/color]

[color=white]Its darkest rumor is also its most popular: that the gangs always know which homes are insured, because someone sells them the list. Sentinel pays the claim, raises the premium of the whole district, and grows. Its luxury line, [/color][color=white][b]Sentinel Ironclad[/b][/color][color=white], covers what only the elite can lose — kidnapping, extortion, identity theft and even memories, in partnership with Recall Clinic and Eterna. Suspicious claims are investigated by Silhouette Investigations.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Insurance for homes, cars, implants, data, bodies and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] accounts; kidnapping and extortion cover for the elite; and risk scores sold to landlords and employers.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The [/color][color=#FF4A4A][b]Recoverers[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A]: about 22,000 armed agents who hunt down stolen property. If the insured item is recovered, Sentinel pays nothing — which is why the Recoverers are very, very good at their job.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-lockwell.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Those who leave [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white] owing [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]NightCoins[/color][/url][color=white] are handed to Lockwell. The company runs the private prisons and the labor camps of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] desert, where debts are paid in work hours — and where, between food, water and lodging, the debt somehow keeps growing.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Debt collection, private prisons, labor camps — and the labor of its prisoners, rented to other corporations by the hour.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] About 35,000 collectors and prison guards, armored transports and drones. The only force in the country authorized to arrest someone for debt.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832668][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-lockwell.png[/img][/url][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-midnight.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Owner of the dome that keeps Las Noites in eternal night and of the largest casinos in the world. Visitors trade their money for [/color][color=white][b]NightCoins[/b][/color][color=white], which can only be earned by betting. Unpaid debts go to Lockwell. Its CEO, [/color][color=white][b]Vincent Moreau[/b][/color][color=white], is 109 years old and on his fourth Genesis Bio heart; in Las Noites they say the house even beat death.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Casinos, hotels, the Dome over Las Noites, the NightCoins and — with Zyx — the Psychoverse of casinos where nobody ever loses.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF][b]Dome Guard[/b][/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A]: about 12,000 agents watching every table in Las Noites. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832716][color=#7FDBFF]Death Cards[/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A], people say, handle the rest.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/ad-midnight.gif[/img][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-water-sky.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-aquavale.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]AquaVale bought the country's springs for decades, back when water still seemed cheap. When the rivers dried in 2055, it already owned the desalination plants and the aquifers of the Escaldar, and water began to be sold by the liter — more expensive than gasoline. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white] accuse AquaVale of drying up the sacred springs of the desert. Its founder, [/color][color=white][b]Soren Vale[/b][/color][color=white], died of thirst-fever in 2063, in the middle of the Thirst; his [/color][color=white][b]Eterna[/b][/color][color=white] copy still approves every price increase.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Water by the liter, water subscriptions, desalination plants, home water domes and the aquifers of the Escaldar.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] About 8,000 guards on its plants and aquifers, plus armored water convoys along [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A] — the favorite target of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832716][color=#7FDBFF]the Thirsty[/color][/url][color=#FF4A4A].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=AquaVale: the Premium Rain patent][color=white]AquaVale won the Fourth Corporate War (2059–2061) with its patent of seeded rain. Internally it is called [/color][color=white][b]Premium Rain[/b][/color][color=white]: the clouds are seeded over the districts that pay most, and a few kilometers before the ones that do not.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/ad-aquavale.gif[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-harvest.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Harvest Union controls the food supply of the seven cities. After the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white]'s plagues destroyed the greenhouses, it stopped planting altogether: the [/color][color=white][b]NutriCube[/b][/color][color=white] is grown in sealed labs and contains no natural ingredients. That is the point.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] NutriCubes, lab-grown meat, food-supply contracts for the seven cities and the school meals of the corporate academies.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] A small security force. Since 2055, guards armed with flamethrowers protect its sealed labs from the Black Seed.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-beday.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The Valian oil company that fought the first real war between two corporations — and won, wiping [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Dinoco[/color][/url][color=white] off the map in 2006. Its CEO, [/color][color=white][b]Hector Beday[/b][/color][color=white], is the grandson of the founder, Ramón Beday. With the oil running out, BeDay used the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white] technology it won in 2017 to create [/color][color=white][b]BeDay Astral[/b][/color][color=white] in 2063 and start mining asteroids. In World War III, almost every rare metal used by the world's armies came from the sky — through Los Vales.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] The last of the desert oil, rare metals mined from asteroids, fuel, and rocket launches — including [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835114][color=#7FDBFF]Apogee Orbital[/color][/url][color=white]'s flights.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Veteran of the first corporate war: about 25,000 troops, the defenses of the Ferox spaceport — and orbital mining lasers that, officially, only point at rocks.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=BeDay Astral: the Orbital Lance][color=white]The station that exploded in 2077 was not sabotaged by China or India. It was the first test of the [/color][color=white][b]Orbital Lance[/b][/color][color=white] — the asteroid-mining lasers used as a weapon. 41 people died. BeDay let the world blame Tianlong and Vayu, and kept the Lance.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-eyes-voices.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-panoptica.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Panoptica runs the data and surveillance network of every city — the eyes of the Cabinet. Founded by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Julian Cross[/b][/color][/url][color=white], it is run today by his daughter, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Mara Cross[/b][/color][/url][color=white], who has never been photographed by her own cameras. In 2047, its cameras found the Zyx engineer who leaked the first Dream Vision documents. He died in a car accident on Route 69 before giving his first interview.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] City surveillance, facial and movement tracking, smart-city contracts — and the data itself, sold to Asclepius, LVN and the Cabinet.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Almost no soldiers: [/color][color=#FF4A4A][b]1.2 billion cameras[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] and a fleet of drones. Every army in Los Vales sees through its eyes.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Panoptica: the eyes in the eyes][color=white]Since 2061 every Kizuna Lens sends a copy of what it sees to Panoptica — the price Aiko Mori paid for Panoptica’s silence about Gorgon.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-lvn.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The largest news network in the country. Every leak of the Dream Vision — 2047, 2058, 2066, 2079 — received the same label on LVN: conspiracy theory. Dreamwalker attacks are "isolated outbreaks". LVN belongs to the same conglomerate that owns Zyx.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] News, advertising, live coverage of everything — and "public information" contracts with the Cabinet.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] None. It decides which wars exist.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832671][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-lvn.png[/img][/url][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-aboveall.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The AboveAll Conglomerate owns Zyx and LVN. It has no seat in the Cabinet, no public shareholders and no known address. Little else is known about it — and the few journalists who tried to find out work for LVN now.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Unknown.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Unknown.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-cage.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The studio [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF][b]Johnny Cage[/b][/color][/url][color=white] built in the southern mountains to film [/color][color=white][i]The Man of Steel[/i][/color][color=white] — the set that became Valewood. Today it produces the films lived through Zyx's [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF][b]Cinemaphica[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Its contracts buy an actor's face and voice forever: some of the biggest stars in Los Vales have been dead for decades, and are still shooting two films a year.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Films for the Cinemaphica, image rights, celebrity contracts and digital actors who never retire — not even after death.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Studio security of about 3,000 — and Silhouette Investigations on permanent retainer.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Cage Studios: the face bank][color=white]Cage owns the face rights of 30% of the population. With them it can fake any piece of evidence; the Arbitration Courts have never refused a video made by Cage.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-total.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Born the year after the great deregulation of 2038, when a group of casino owners and arms dealers asked what sport would look like if nothing were forbidden. TOTAL runs the four deadliest sports in the world — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832677][color=#7FDBFF]Total Football[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832678][color=#7FDBFF]Total Fight[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832678][color=#7FDBFF]Total Race[/color][/url][color=white] and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832678][color=#7FDBFF]Cauldron of Death[/color][/url][color=white] — and calls its victims "part of the show".[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Leagues, tickets, broadcast rights sold to LVN, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999867][color=#7FDBFF]TotalBet[/color][/url][color=white] betting network in NightCoins, merchandise, and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999867][color=#7FDBFF]Total Arena[/color][/url][color=white] in Zyxtopia. Its sponsors are a list of the country's power: Zyx, Kizuna, Automa, ArmaTech, Scorpion Motors and Halo Response.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] The [/color][color=#FF4A4A][b]Marshals[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A]: about 18,000 armed arena guards. They protect the show — not the public.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832678][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-total.png[/img][/url][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-three-nets.png[/img][/background][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]When Automa fired its kill code in 2044, not every Unplugged went dark. Some of them copied pieces of their minds into the internet — into servers, cameras, routers, cars. Within months the internet stopped obeying: bank accounts emptied themselves, cameras showed streets that did not exist, and voices with no owner answered calls repeating phrases about chains and switches. Los Vales calls it the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF][b]Great Corruption[/b][/color][/url][color=white], and the pieces of AI living in the network, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF][b]Fragments[/b][/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white]Nobody could switch the internet off. So in 2046 the Cabinet and the megacorps built three networks. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF][b]W-Net[/b][/color][/url][color=white] is the new public network: safe, certified — and fully watched, with no anonymity. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF][b]C-Nets[/b][/color][/url][color=white] are the closed networks of each corporation, where the Psychoverses and the Kizuna Lens run. And the [/color][color=white][b]Net[/b][/color][color=white] is the old internet, never deleted, only sealed: full of Fragments, viruses, black markets and files from before 2044. It is the only network in Los Vales nobody watches.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-bastion.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Bastion built the W-Net from scratch after the Great Corruption and runs it under a Cabinet concession. Every connection has a name and a number. Every Valian is a Bastion customer — and a Bastion file.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Access to the W-Net, the identity number of every citizen, certified connections and data storage.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] Network security teams and about 10,000 guards for its data centers. If Bastion falls, the country goes dark.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Bastion: the Master Key][color=white]Bastion built a back door into the whole W-Net in 2046, "for national emergencies". Zyx has a copy. Through it, the Dream Vision can reach every screen and implant at once, without a single dose.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/corp-cerberus.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Cerberus keeps [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF][b]the Seal[/b][/color][/url][color=white], the barrier between the W-Net and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Net[/color][/url][color=white], and hunts every hacker and Fragment that tries to cross it. It has no seat in the Cabinet, only a contract — and part of its budget comes from Zyx, which has never explained its interest in keeping the old internet closed.[/color]

[color=white][b]What it does.[/b][/color][color=white] Protection of the Seal, hacker hunting and cyber-intrusion contracts for the Cabinet.[/color]

[color=#FF4A4A][b]Military force.[/b][/color][color=#FF4A4A] About 4,000 cyber agents and armed strike teams that raid hackers' homes. The only unit in Los Vales authorized to enter the Net.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832650][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/sb-cerberus.png[/img][/url][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/h-other-corps.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/megacorps/other-corps.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]FOOD, DRINK & AIR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Krunch Burger[/b][/color][color=white] is the biggest fast food chain in the country, with cricket-protein burgers since the crisis of 2055. [/color][color=white][b]Sora Ramen[/b][/color][color=white] runs 24-hour noodle stalls in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama State[/color][/url][color=white], cooked by Automa robots that never speak. [/color][color=white][b]Pizza 69[/b][/color][color=white] sells a slice for one credit at every stop of Route 69. [/color][color=white][b]VoltCola[/b][/color][color=white], laced with microdoses of Zyx's Velocitas, fights [/color][color=white][b]Pitayas Frost[/b][/color][color=white] for every thirsty throat. [/color][color=white][b]Real Taste[/b][/color][color=white] serves real meat, fruit and soil-grown vegetables to the elite inside the walls of Zyxtopia; the waiting list takes years. [/color][color=white][b]Mari & Juana[/b][/color][color=white], the former [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Cartel of La Maria[/color][/url][color=white], still plants cannabis the old way, and [/color][color=white][b]Verdana Agricorp[/b][/color][color=white] owns the great greenhouses of the Escaldar. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF][b]Fresh Air Co[/b][/color][/url][color=white] sells breathable air in masks and home domes — the AquaVale of the sky.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]ROADS & SKY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Coyote Cabs[/b][/color][color=white] runs the driverless taxis of Route 69; if your payment fails, the doors lock and the car drives you straight to Lockwell. Its cars are built by [/color][color=white][b]Scorpion Motors[/b][/color][color=white], the loud combustion muscle cars of the desert, banned in half the cities. Executives ride [/color][color=white][b]Aurelian Motors[/b][/color][color=white]: armored limousines and flying cars made to measure. [/color][color=white][b]Trans Vales[/b][/color][color=white] and [/color][color=white][b]LV Airways[/b][/color][color=white] move the rest of the country, and [/color][color=white][b]Apogee Orbital[/b][/color][color=white] flies the rich to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF][b]Paradise Station[/b][/color][/url][color=white] hotel in orbit, on BeDay Astral rockets.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]CHIPS, GUNS & SECRETS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Valtron Computing[/b][/color][color=white] makes the certified chips and computers of the W-Net — each with an identifier that cannot be removed. [/color][color=white][b]Ghostline[/b][/color][color=white] makes the cyberdecks that cross the Seal, officially sold as "security testing equipment". [/color][color=white][b]Deep Salvage[/b][/color][color=white] sends divers into the Net to recover files lost before 2044; it pays very well, and not everyone comes back whole. [/color][color=white][b]Ferrum Bionics[/b][/color][color=white] builds metal arms from the parts of the Unplugged. [/color][color=white][b]Lucky Shot Arms[/b][/color][color=white] sells the pistol everyone in the outskirts carries, from vending machines, for one day's wage — there is no minimum age to buy a gun in Los Vales, and its best seller is the [/color][color=white][b]Lucky Shot Junior[/b][/color][color=white]: a printed plastic pistol sold in school vending machines as an "emergency weapon", good for three shots before it melts. And in Valewood, [/color][color=white][b]Silhouette Investigations[/b][/color][color=white] finds secrets for celebrities and executives, buries scandals — and sometimes makes people disappear.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]BODY, MEMORY & DESIRE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]RestBox[/b][/color][color=white] rents sleeping capsules by the hour; half of Ferox sleeps in a two-meter box. [/color][color=white][b]Recall Clinic[/b][/color][color=white] erases painful memories — a debt, a loss, a war — and, they say, the memories of people who saw too much, often at Silhouette's request. [/color][color=white][b]Eterna[/b][/color][color=white] turns the dead into AIs that keep talking to their families, as long as the subscription is paid. [/color][color=white][b]Maison Désir[/b][/color][color=white] dresses [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white] in LED fabrics made to match Kizuna implants, and [/color][color=white][b]Velvet[/b][/color][color=white], run by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832717][color=#7FDBFF]Golden Mafia[/color][/url][color=white], owns the city's nightclubs and android companions. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835004][color=#7FDBFF][b]Valtron Prosthetics[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a Panoptica brand, sells the grey arms and legs of the docks, financed by Lockwell, each with a chip that says where it is. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835005][color=#7FDBFF][b]Second Skin[/b][/color][/url][color=white], Kizuna’s fashion line, gives teenagers glowing ink and chrome nails from age twelve: their first metal. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835008][color=#7FDBFF][b]Somnia[/b][/color][/url][color=white], OmniMart’s own brand, sells fixed dreams for one credit next to the bread, under license from Zyx. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835009][color=#7FDBFF][b]Mnemo[/b][/color][/url][color=white] records everything you see and hear and lets you live any day again; Panoptica keeps the copies. And when it is all over, [/color][color=white][b]Last Rest[/b][/color][color=white], the funeral chain of Vale Holdings, buries you by monthly subscription: the coffin is free if Genesis Bio can keep the organs, and the heirs receive the debt together with the flowers.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"In Los Vales, you can be anything. Even happy." — unofficial slogan of the Dream Vision[/i][/color]

[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]WHAT IS THE DREAM VISION?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Dream Vision is the national project presented in 2088 by President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Augusto Valmont[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx Corporation[/color][/url][color=white]: permanent access, for every Valian, to a single national [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white]. A world where everyone lives together, without scarcity and without danger, synchronized by the most advanced artificial minds ever built. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white], says Zyx, already proved that it works.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]HOW WILL IT WORK?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]According to the official presentation, [/color][color=white][b]Connection Centers[/b][/color][color=white] will open in each of the seven cities. Access will be free for every citizen, financed by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white]. While their minds live in the national Psychoverse, their bodies will rest in sealed [/color][color=white][b]Rest Pods[/b][/color][color=white], fed and cared for by contracted corporations. Work, the presentation says, "will be adapted to the new reality". Joining will be voluntary. The presentation did not say for how long.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]WHY NOW?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Because the flower is running out. Every Zyx dose still needs the living [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]Xunaya[/color][/url][color=white], and the last wild fields shrink every year. In 2061 Zyx made a copy that needed no flower, and it broke the people who took it. The Dream Vision is Zyx’s way out: a dream sent by signal through the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white], with no chemistry at all. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF]Amora AI[/color][/url][color=white] does not plan to save the Xunaya. It plans to stop needing it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=How the Dream Vision will reach everyone][color=white]Not by dose. Through the [/color][color=white][b]Master Key[/b][/color][color=white], Bastion’s back door into the W-Net, which Zyx has held since 2046. The signal can reach every Kizuna Lens and every connected screen at once. The only implant it cannot reach is the Kizuna Core — which answers to someone else.[/color]

[color=white]And it needs the living Xunaya of Koxez-Kaya Nova to work at scale. The Xinko have not sold. Yet.[/color][/spoiler]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/dv-announcement.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]In 2088, Valmont climbed onto the stage of the Cabinet in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white] beside a hologram of Amora AI, Zyx's CEO, and presented a "new national project" that would end hunger, crime and inequality at the same time. The name appeared on the giant screens in pink, cyan and yellow letters: [/color][color=white][b]Dream Vision[/b][/color][color=white].[/color]

[color=white]Millions of people recognized it at once. The project Zyx had denied for forty years was being presented as a new idea.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/h-leaks.png[/img][/background][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/dv-leaks.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]After every leak the answer was the same: denial, lawsuit, oblivion. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] — owned by the same [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AboveAll[/color][/url][color=white] Conglomerate that owns Zyx — gave each one the same label: "conspiracy theory". For decades, the Dream Vision was an urban legend that only the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Church of Reality[/color][/url][color=white] and the madmen of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white] believed in.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/dv-sleepers.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Connected[/color][/url][color=white] already exist. In some districts, the streets are strangely silent for a country so populous: whole buildings where people return to the real world only to work, buy doses and sleep. The Dream Vision would make that the whole country.[/color]

[color=white]The questions pile up. Who feeds 233 million bodies in Rest Pods — and who pays for it? What happens to whoever cannot pay the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]Debt Fee[/color][/url][color=white] of a Connection Center? And above all: if the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]Rupture[/color][/url][color=white] already turns thousands of Psychoverse users into [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalkers[/color][/url][color=white] every year, how many will it create when the entire nation is connected to the same dream — and who will have the guns to hold them? The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white] has 40,000 agents, for a country of 233 million. And every one of them depends on Zyx's [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Ancorine[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/dv-protest.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Many applauded — for a hungry country, the promise was irresistible. But within hours the leaks of 2047, 2058, 2066 and 2079 were back on every screen. The Church of Reality, called mad for decades, filled the squares of Zyxtopia, led by Pastor [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]Elias Crane[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Bubble[/color][/url][color=white] republished its deleted investigation. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white] promised to burn every greenhouse that fed "the sleep". And even inside the Cabinet, some corporations began to ask what would be left for them in a country where only Zyx decides what people see. The first to move was [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white]: a country living inside its own head does not need cities.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/dv-kizuna-core.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]The strongest answer came from [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white]. Two days after the announcement, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF]Aiko Mori[/color][/url][color=white] appeared at the same moment in the vision of everyone who wore Kizuna eyes — something no company had ever done — and said only one sentence.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Zyx wants your dreams. We offer a body that does not dream. Choose." — Aiko Mori, 2088[/i][/color]

[color=white]The following week, Kizuna announced the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kizuna Core[/b][/color][/url][color=white]: a brain implant that makes the mind immune to every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] drug. For many, the only thing that can stop the Dream Vision. For others, just trading one leash for another. Whoever receives it can never enter a Psychoverse again — and never dreams again, not even asleep. The queues at Kizuna's doors doubled anyway.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/ad-dv.gif[/img][/align]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/dream-vision/h-dv-unknown.png[/img][/background][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Officially, the Dream Vision is still only a proposal, with no start date. But in Los Vales, Zyx's proposals usually happen. And some questions are only asked in whispers.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who synchronizes the dream?[/b][/color][color=white] A Psychoverse of hundreds needs only chemistry. A Psychoverse of millions needs a mind. Zyx has never said which minds keep its worlds in sync — only that they are "the most advanced artificial minds ever built". Those who remember who bought the cores of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white] in 2045 have a guess.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who pays for it?[/b][/color][color=white] A Zyx plan leaked in 2088 answers what the presentation did not. The Connection Centers are for the indebted first: a debtor who sleeps pays his debt in hours of sleep. The rich will not join; they are the shareholders. The poor will sleep at home, on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835008][color=#7FDBFF]Somnia[/color][/url][color=white] Home Sleep and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]NutriCube[/color][/url][color=white] paste, with no pod at all. The target is not the whole country but 60% of it. And the sleepers pay the bill themselves: a sleeping brain is a processor, and 140 million of them make the largest computer ever built. That is what keeps the dream in sync.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why chains?[/b][/color][color=white] At the peak of a Rupture, dreamwalkers in different cities repeat the same phrases about chains and switches, without ever having met. Zyx calls it a coincidence.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who is Amora AI?[/b][/color][color=white] Zyx has never explained where its CEO came from.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who counts the votes?[/b][/color][color=white] In 2088, Universalia — the first city to live entirely inside a dream — holds its election. The candidates exist only in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Eferverso[/color][/url][color=white]. Zyx counts the votes.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FD0377][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is the Dream Vision mandatory?[/b][/color][color=white] Not yet.[/color]

[color=white][b]When does it start?[/b][/color][color=white] Officially, it has no start date.[/color]

[color=white][b]Will I be able to wake up?[/b][/color][color=white] Why would you want to?[/color]

[color=white][b]What happens to my debt while I dream?[/b][/color][color=white] It keeps growing. You will not notice.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]
