[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-corporate-wars/article-corporate-wars.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BACKGROUND[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Corporations had fought before — the Railroad War of the 1870s was sabotage, militias and executives dying in "accidents". But until 2001 no company had fought another with a real army. Los Vales, a State run by a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white], was the first place where that became possible.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE FIRST CORPORATE WAR (2001–2006)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The oil companies [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]BeDay[/b][/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF][b]Dinoco[/b][/color][/url][color=white] went from price wars to sabotage and then to open combat: private armies, attacks on bases and offshore platforms. BeDay won, Dinoco disappeared, and the spill poisoned the coast for years. The world learned a new word: [/color][color=white][b]MegaCorp[/b][/color][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-corporate-wars/fig-corporate-wars-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SECOND CORPORATE WAR (2016–2017)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]When the bankrupt American space agency [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white] went up for sale, Japan’s [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white] wanted it. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white] CEO [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF][b]Phill Stuart[/b][/color][/url][color=white] fought the deal — and in 2015 he disappeared, kidnapped by Nakama and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white]. The urban war that followed pitted Sphere, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] and BeDay against Nakama and ArmaTech, with Los Vales as the battlefield. Stuart died in a bombing error. The Valian alliance won and split NASC’s technology; the only Nakama plant left standing was the one whose director had refused to fight — the future [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE THIRD CORPORATE WAR (2019–2022)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]ArmaTech could not beat WM head-on while WM held the only nuclear arsenal on the continent. So it attacked from inside: it funded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white]’s preacher-mayor [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Tomas Dolphin[/color][/url][color=white], who plunged the capital into chaos, while its hackers spent three years stealing WM’s plans and buying its people. In 2022 they took control of a warhead being flown from the roof of WM’s tower. The security system detonated it. [/color][color=white][b]Hermosa evaporated[/b][/color][color=white], with almost two million people, President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Samuel Reyes[/color][/url][color=white] and half the government.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CONSEQUENCES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Nobody won the Third Corporate War. WM lost its headquarters and its monopoly; WM’s nuclear secrets began leaking to the world; and in the ruins, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] found the survivors it would turn into the first citizens of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SETTLEMENT OF 2023[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]WM never went to war over Hermosa. In 2023, without admitting anything, ArmaTech signed the [/color][color=white][b]Settlement of 2023[/b][/color][color=white] "in the name of national unity": half of its defense orders would pass through WM, forever. That is the origin of the joint defense contracts both still hold. WM rebuilt itself on ArmaTech money; ArmaTech bought its way out of a war it could not win.[/color]

[color=white]Inside the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] the two vote together. Outside it, the war never ended. Their gangs fight over the same streets, and each side has paid saboteurs during the other’s strikes.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE FOURTH CORPORATE WAR (2059–2061)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Aquifer War. In 2058 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] collapsed into the empty aquifers of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Harvest Union[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Verdana Agricorp[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white], which wanted the land, accused [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] of having pumped the desert dry and tried to seize the wells. AquaVale answered with the Vale family’s insurer, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Sentinel Mutual[/color][/url][color=white], and the WM army.[/color]

[color=white]It ended in 2061 with AquaVale’s patent of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]seeded rain[/color][/url][color=white]: whoever owned the clouds won the war. Harvest Union lost its greenhouses and stopped planting — the birth of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]NutriCube[/color][/url][color=white] — and the "Insurance War" of 2062 between [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Halo Response[/color][/url][color=white] and the insurers was the last battle of its aftermath.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][b][background=#D9B45A][color=#0c1020] The Charter [/color][/background][color=#D9B45A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#D9B45A]The Cabinet[/color][/url][color=#D9B45A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#D9B45A]Leaders[/color][/url][color=#D9B45A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#D9B45A]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#D9B45A][b]PREAMBLE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"We, the creditors and shareholders of Los Vales, having received the Republic in settlement of its debts, establish these Free States, so that every citizen may be free to buy, to sell, to owe and to pay." — The Charter, 2028[/i][/color]

[size=130][color=#D9B45A][b]A SHORT HISTORY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][color=white][b]Valian Constitution of 2013[/b][/color][color=white] created the Republic: a president, ministries, courts and, beside them, a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] that only "advised". When the Republic went bankrupt in 2028, its creditors did not abolish it; they rewrote it. The [/color][color=white][b]Charter of the Free States[/b][/color][color=white] was drafted in nine days by the lawyers of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] and signed the day [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Helena Vasquez[/color][/url][color=white] left office. It is the law of the land to this day.[/color]

[color=white]The Charter can be amended by a simple majority of the Cabinet: 22 of its 42 votes. It has been amended 311 times.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][size=150][b][color=#F3E6C4]THE ARTICLES[/color][/b][/size][/align]
[align=center][b][color=#D9B45A]ABRIDGED · THE FULL TEXT IS AVAILABLE AT EVERY ARBITRATION COURT FOR A FEE[/color][/b][/align]
[table]
[tr][td][color=#D9B45A][b]ARTICLE[/b][/color][/td][td][color=#D9B45A][b]TEXT[/b][/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]I · The State[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]Los Vales is a free market. Everything that can be bought is permitted. Nothing that stops a sale is. The State is a provider of services, and every service it provides shall pay for itself.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]II · The Cabinet[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]The laws are written by the Corporate Cabinet. Each seat is bought, and each seat votes according to the weight of its owner.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]III · The President[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]The President is appointed by the Cabinet, serves for as long as the Cabinet wishes, signs every law it passes and commands the Anchor Squad.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]IV · The Citizen[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]A citizen is the holder of a valid Citizen ID, renewed every year for a fee. An expired ID is an expired citizen.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]V · Property[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]Everything can be owned: land, water, roads, names, data — and, since the Ortega Law of 2054, faces.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]VI · Debt[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]Every debt shall be paid. Debts are transferable and inheritable. The Debt Accord of 2028 binds every generation until the national debt is paid.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]VII · Contracts[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]A contract signed is a contract owed. A child of twelve may sign one. Breaking a contract creates a debt.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]VIII · Security[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]There is no national army. Defense, police and prisons are provided by licensed corporations under contract with the Cabinet.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]IX · The Cities[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]Each of the seven cities holds a charter from the Cabinet and elects its mayor every seven years. Votes may be sold. The elections are kept because the trade treaties of the Pacific Union recognize only an elected government.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]X · Freedom[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]Every citizen is free to desire. The State will not stand between a citizen and a product.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]XI · Foreign Enterprise[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]No foreign company may operate in Los Vales. A foreign company may only enter through a Valian company with its headquarters in Los Vales, named in English and followed by "of Los Vales" (the Nakama Act of 2018, kept by this Charter).[/color][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#D9B45A][b]THE NAKAMA ACT (2018)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]Second Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white] a foreign company, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white], took orders from Osaka on Valian soil, kidnapped a Valian CEO and turned its factories into war lines. In 2018 the young Republic answered with the [/color][color=white][b]Foreign Enterprise Act[/b][/color][color=white], which everyone calls the [/color][color=white][b]Nakama Act[/b][/color][color=white], and the Charter of 2028 kept it as Article XI.[/color]

[color=white]A foreign company that wants to sell, hire or own anything in Los Vales must found a Valian company, with its headquarters in Los Vales and the parent’s name [/color][color=white][b]translated into English, followed by "of Los Vales"[/b][/color][color=white]: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Tianlong[/color][/url][color=white] became [/color][color=white][i]Sky Dragon of Los Vales[/i][/color][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Kaiyō Lines[/color][/url][color=white] [/color][color=white][i]Ocean Lines of Los Vales[/i][/color][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Drexler[/color][/url][color=white] [/color][color=white][i]Turner Industries of Los Vales[/i][/color][color=white]. The subsidiary is only half free: the parent may own at most 49%, half its board must be Valian citizens, and the parent may not give it orders on security, war or the Cabinet. In a war with the parent’s country, the Cabinet takes it. Every credit of profit that leaves the country pays the Sovereignty Fee. Its first consequence was [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white]: Nakama Vales had to become Valian, and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF]Haruka Mori[/color][/url][color=white] bought it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

The Dividend is raised for the first time since 2029, to 900 credits — and is lost for a strike, a conviction or a debt in arrears.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#F3E6C4]311th · Dream Vision[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]2088[/color][/td][td][color=#D8DCEA]The Dream Vision is a national project. No city may forbid it.[/color][/td][/tr]

[spoiler=Clause Zero][color=white]The Debt Accord of 2028 has a clause that was never read aloud: if the national debt is ever paid in full, the Free States are dissolved and the Republic of 2013 returns, with elections. That is why the Meridian Trust makes sure the interest always grows faster than the Debt Fee. The debt is not a bill. It is a lock.[/color]

[color=white]In 2086 a photo of that page reached Neon Wire, and the Clause Zero Movement was born. What its members do not know: every credit they pay is matched by a new interest adjustment, and the lawyers who defend the Movement are paid, in secret, by Portenova Corp — which lost its Cabinet seat in 2085 and wants elections back.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The 112th Amendment and the votes of the dead][color=white]The Eterna Amendment of 2062 was written for a single man: Soren Vale, who was dying in the middle of the Thirst. What nobody checked is where the copies run. Every Eterna AI lives on servers owned by the AboveAll Conglomerate — so the dead chairs of OmniMart, Vale Holdings and WM-Automa vote as AboveAll wants: 14 votes. With the 6 votes of Zyx, that is 20 of the 22 needed for a majority.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#D9B45A][b]THE CLAUSE ZERO MOVEMENT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since 2086 a national crowdfunding — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835002][color=#7FDBFF][b]Buy a Piece of the Debt[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — has tried to pay off the debt of 2028, which according to a page leaked to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white] would dissolve the Free States and bring back the Republic. It has paid 0.8%. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] says the page is a forgery; the Meridian Trust raises the interest every time the counter moves.[/color]

[size=130][color=#D9B45A][b]HOW JUSTICE WORKS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]There are no public judges, only the [/color][color=white][b]Arbitration Courts[/b][/color][color=white] of the Cabinet, which charge a fee for every hearing. Whoever cannot pay the fee cannot be heard, and whoever is not heard loses. Corporations have their own permanent seats in the courts and are never charged. Sentences are served at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"The Charter does not tell you what is right. It tells you what it costs." — Arbitration Court proverb[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=white]The country still pays for the bankruptcy of 2028: every public bill carries the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF][b]Debt Fee[/b][/color][/url][color=white], sent straight to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white]. Families pay too. The average Valian household owes [/color][color=white][b]61,000 credits[/b][/color][color=white] — implants bought in installments, school contracts broken, Halo bills, OmniCredit overdrafts and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]NightCoins[/color][/url][color=white] lost under the Dome. Debts are inheritable, and Lockwell collects them all: first the implants, then the salary, then the face, and at the end the worker.[/color]

[color=white]At the top, the money moves the other way. The ten conglomerates of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] hold most of the wealth of the country and most of its debt bonds, which means that every credit a Valian pays in interest goes back to the same companies that pay the wages. The economists of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] call it "a closed and efficient system". [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white] calls it "the wheel".[/color]

[color=white][b]Why it does not collapse.[/b][/color][color=white] The debt was never meant to be paid — only to earn. A debt that is paid stops earning; a debt that is never paid earns forever. Lockwell packs Valian debts and sells them, and the Meridian Trust sells them abroad as [/color][color=white][b]Valian Debt Bonds[/b][/color][color=white], so half the world earns a little from every Valian who owes. And the companies do not live on luxury: few can buy a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Real Taste[/color][/url][color=white] dinner, but everyone buys water, air and a room. The money of the poor is small, but it never stops coming.[/color]

[color=white][b]The people in the middle.[/b][/color][color=white] About one Valian in seven belongs to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835313][color=#7FDBFF][b]contract class[/b][/color][/url][color=white]: engineers, clerks, nurses and managers with a corporate contract, a company flat, a health plan and a school place for their children. They live well, and they buy what the poor cannot — until the contract ends, and they lose everything on the same day. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835313][color=#7FDBFF]The Contract Class →[/color][/url]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Everyone pays. Eventually." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][i]Grant Lockwell[/i][/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][background=#FF0276][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/economy/h-eco-dividend.png[/img][/background][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Since 2029 every citizen with a valid Citizen ID receives a monthly slice of the profits of the ten conglomerates: the [/color][color=white][b]Dividend[/b][/color][color=white], the price the Cabinet paid for the Free States a year after the Bankruptcy. It was frozen at 300 credits for fifty-one years and raised only in 2081, to about [/color][color=white][b]900 credits[/b][/color][color=white], in the same week the Cabinet crushed the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF]OmniCredits Strike[/color][/url][color=white]. Today it pays the rent of a room in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white]. For the poor it is less than the Debt Fee they pay, so on paper they lose money every month. Nobody risks losing it anyway: a debt in arrears, a conviction or a strike and you "get cut". It is the most feared punishment in the country.[/color]

[color=white][b]Nobody leaves.[/b][/color][color=white] A citizen who leaves in debt loses the Citizen ID, and under the [/color][color=white][b]Collection Convention[/b][/color][color=white] of 2052 the countries that owe the Meridian Trust collect Valian debtors abroad and send them back to Lockwell. Only the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white] never signed.[/color]

[color=white][b]Free, unless you have a contract.[/b][/color][color=white] There is no minimum age for drugs or guns. Elite schools, gated condos and executive jobs carry [/color][color=white][b]Conduct Clauses[/b][/color][color=white] that cost a family its place if a child is caught; total freedom is left to the free schools of the outskirts. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833648][color=#7FDBFF]The Dividend →[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]2047 — THE ENGINEER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] engineer, [/color][color=white][b]Tobias Varga[/b][/color][color=white], handed journalists in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white] documents with the name "[/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white]" and fled. Among them was a page nobody understood at the time: the plan of a "master key" that Bastion had built into the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white] a year before, able to reach every device with a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Valtron[/color][/url][color=white] chip — and only those. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white] cameras found him. He died in a car crash on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] before his first interview, and the documents were declared fake. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white] still keeps his page.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]2058 — THE BLACK SEED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]At the height of the Thirst, Black Seed hackers broke into Zyx servers and published plans for the mass distribution of doses. Zyx said they were "logistics studies for emergencies".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]2066 — LUCÍA FERRAZ[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Bubble[/color][/url][color=white] published the most complete investigation ever written about the project, secretly funded by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] and signed by reporter [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832546][color=#7FDBFF]Lucía Ferraz[/color][/url][color=white]. Zyx sued, won in the courts of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white], and the article was erased; [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna Lens[/color][/url][color=white] kept showing it for three more days. Ferraz disappeared the following year.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]2079 — THE VIDEO[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A leaked internal video showed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF]Amora AI[/color][/url][color=white] presenting directors with a "National Connection schedule". Zyx said it was a training simulation.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE PATTERN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Each time the answer was the same: denial, lawsuit, forgetting. The denial was handled by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white], owned by the same [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AboveAll[/color][/url][color=white] Conglomerate that owns Zyx, which gave every leak the same label: "conspiracy theory". For most Valians the Dream Vision became an urban legend — until 2088, when President Valmont and Amora AI presented it as a brand-new national project.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=What the engineer of 2047 carried][color=white]The Zyx engineer who leaked the first Dream Vision papers in 2047 did not only carry documents. He carried the first copy of the Master Key, which Bastion had built a year earlier. Panoptica found him; the copy was never recovered. Neon Wire says the Fragments have it.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE RECALL CLINIC[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2082 the [/color][color=white][b]Recall Clinic[/b][/color][color=white] opened in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white], promising to erase a bad memory in a two-hour session: a debt, a grief, a war. Its first clients were survivors of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]Night of Voices[/color][/url][color=white], who had spent six years forbidden to talk about the sentence on the screens and only wanted to forget it. The queue went around the block. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Silhouette Investigations[/b][/color][/url][color=white] soon became its most loyal client — sending in whoever had seen what they should not.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]RECALL HOLES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The erasing is not clean. A memory taken out leaves a [/color][color=white][b]Recall hole[/b][/color][color=white]: the patient knows something is missing, the way the tongue keeps finding a lost tooth. Skills stay — a soldier who erased a war still knows how to shoot — and so do the feelings around the gap: some patients cry at a song and do not know why. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white]’s scanners can see a hole, and since 2085 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]Arbitration Courts[/color][/url][color=white] accept one as evidence. On the street, someone who forgot something convenient "has a hole".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE 2084 SCANDAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]After the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]Great Collection[/color][/url][color=white] of 2083, the clinic offered, at a discount, to erase the memory of having an implant pulled out in the street. One of those patients recovered part of her memory in a Halo hospital and remembered something else from the waiting room: the faces of President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Dalia Monteiro[/color][/url][color=white]’s aides, coming in through the back door. Monteiro had used the clinic to erase witnesses of a secret deal with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white]. She resigned in 2084. Few people remember exactly what she was accused of, which many consider proof that it was true.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]ETERNA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Eterna[/b][/color][color=white] turns the dead into an artificial intelligence that talks with the family for as long as the subscription is paid. When the bill is late, grandfather stops answering. Its first client was [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF]Johnny Cage[/color][/url][color=white], whose digital self has since signed contracts for films the real one never made.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE ZYX VERSION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Zyx sells the memory trade from the other side: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF][i]Second Chance[/i][/color][/url][color=white], a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] in which you relive the best day of your life, built from your own memories. In Los Vales, people say, even remembering costs money.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Why the Recall Clinic was founded][color=white]The Recall Clinic did not open in 2082 to erase debts and grief. Its first clients were the people who saw the [/color][color=white][b]Night of Voices[/b][/color][color=white] in 2076 — and most of them did not come on their own. The clinic was built, with Cerberus money, to erase one memory from one million people.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THREE MONEYS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Valians are paid in credits, but not everyone spends them freely. In [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white] visitors swap their money for [/color][color=white][b]NightCoins[/b][/color][color=white], issued by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Midnight Holdings[/color][/url][color=white], which can be bought but only won back by betting. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white] pays part of every salary in [/color][color=white][b]OmniCredits[/b][/color][color=white], accepted only at OmniMart. In 2080 OmniMart printed too many and they lost two thirds of their value; the strike of 2081 was crushed in three days, and the OmniCredits are still there.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DEBT EVERYWHERE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The few public services left carry the [/color][color=white][b]Debt Fee[/b][/color][color=white]: the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]Arbitration Courts[/color][/url][color=white] charge per hearing, the citizen ID is renewed every year for a fee, and when the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white] takes someone the family receives the bill. Children who break their school contracts start adult life in debt.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE DEBT IS THE PRODUCT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Nobody in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] expects the debt to be paid. A debt that is paid stops earning; a debt that is never paid earns forever. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] packs Valian debts and sells them, and since 2052 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] has sold them abroad as [/color][color=white][b]Valian Debt Bonds[/b][/color][color=white], held by pension funds in Osaka, Lagos and Zurich. A worker in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] pays interest to a retired teacher in Japan who has never heard of him.[/color]

[color=white]The companies do not live on luxury either. Few Valians can buy a dinner at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Real Taste[/color][/url][color=white], but everyone buys water from [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white], air from [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]Fresh Air Co[/color][/url][color=white] and a room from Portenova. The money of the poor is small, but it never stops coming.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]LOCKWELL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Debt ends at [/color][color=white][b]Lockwell[/b][/color][color=white], which runs private prisons, labor camps in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] and a maximum-security prison island off the coast. Many never finish paying. Some try the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832678][color=#7FDBFF]Cauldron of Death[/color][/url][color=white], where the prize for Lockwell prisoners is the end of their debt; most of its drivers are lent by Lockwell to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]TOTAL[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE GREAT COLLECTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Between 2047 and 2051 Lockwell sold cybernetics in 60 installments, and one in three Valians bought a part on credit. Almost nobody read the clause: until the last payment, the part belonged to Lockwell. In 2083, after the strike, Lockwell collected — arms unscrewed at bus stops, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] eyes pulled out at front doors. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Genesis Bio[/color][/url][color=white] bought the used parts.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-money-debt/fig-money-debt-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]COLLATERAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]Ortega Law[/color][/url][color=white] of 2054 made faces sellable, Lockwell also accepts your face as collateral.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Project Twin][color=white]The "workers with the same face" in the factories of Ferox are real. Genesis Bio grows them from the DNA of Lockwell debtors who died in the Escaldar camps — the contract says the debtor’s body belongs to the creditor, and Genesis reads "body" generously. The debt dies. The worker does not.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE COUP OF 2012[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The crash of 2009 did not stop at Los Vales. Across the United States the virtual-currency collapse wiped out savings, pensions and three of the five largest banks; by 2011 Washington had defaulted twice, cities were run by private security and whole states paid their police in company scrip. Congress could no longer pass a budget. In the summer of 2012, after a failed election left two men claiming the presidency, the Joint Chiefs led by [/color][color=white][b]General Harlan Kane[/b][/color][color=white] took the capital in a single night. They suspended the Constitution "until order is restored" and created the [/color][color=white][b]Directorate of National Recovery[/b][/color][color=white]. Order has not been restored since.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-nau/fig-nau-1.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SECOND AMERICAN CIVIL WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The coup broke the country. Texas, the Great Lakes and the West refused to obey; militias took cities; corporations armed whole districts. The [/color][color=white][b]Second American Civil War[/b][/color][color=white] lasted seven years. In 2013 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white] declared Los Vales independent, and when the Directorate sent troops, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] was waiting with the forgotten warheads of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Coronnel[/color][/url][color=white]. It was the first time a corporation defeated a State in open war. By 2019 the Directorate had won back most of the East and renamed what it held the [/color][color=white][b]New American Union[/b][/color][color=white]. It never won back the West.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WATER AND WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]From 2041 to 2043 the two countries fought the [/color][color=white][b]Colorado Water War[/b][/color][color=white] over the last great river crossing the border: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] dammed it, the Union bombed a dam, WM defended the rest. Six years later the Union invaded outright in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]Reunification War[/color][/url][color=white] of 2049 and lost again — the last time anyone tried. It has never signed a peace. Every year it rebuilds its stockpiles with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Liberty Ordnance[/color][/url][color=white], and every year General [/color][color=white][b]Marcus Holt[/b][/color][color=white] promises to "bring the West home".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WALL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since 2084 famine inside the Union has pushed millions toward the border. The Union built the [/color][color=white][b]Wall[/b][/color][color=white] to keep its people in; Los Vales calls it the Wall of the East and lets [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] sell "work visas" to whoever crosses. The labor camps of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] have doubled. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cerberus[/color][/url][color=white] hacks the Union’s border systems; the Union accuses Los Vales of human trafficking. Meanwhile the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] holds old United States debt that the Union refuses to pay, and has frozen American assets all over the world.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE FIRST CASE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2033 an unemployed actor who spent eighteen hours a day in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Cinemaphica[/color][/url][color=white] left home with a gun and killed fourteen people at a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white] studio. When arrested he did not understand why he was in handcuffs: for him, the people around him were extras, the bullets were special effects, and nothing he did had consequences. The press called him [/color][color=white][b]The Protagonist[/b][/color][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHAT RUPTURE IS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Doctors named the condition [/color][color=white][b]Rupture[/b][/color][color=white]: the mind of someone who lives too long in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverses[/color][/url][color=white] loses the border between dream and world, and begins to see reality as one more Psychoverse — a place where nothing matters, nobody is real and nothing can be punished. The most violent cases mix Psychoverses with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] combat stimulants like [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Neurotox[/color][/url][color=white] and with cheap implants. A dreamwalker with metal arms who believes the world is a dream is the most dangerous thing that can walk a Valian street.[/color]

[color=white]Since the 2060s a new cause has filled the clinics: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF][b]Ghostthorn[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a cheap street copy of a Zyx formula that never loses its strength — and never lets go. A dose costs a tenth of a real Psychoverse, and the poorest districts of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white] produce the most dreamwalkers in the country.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE PHRASES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]After 2045 the cases tripled. Doctors noticed something stranger: many patients, at the peak of a crisis, repeated the same phrases — about chains, about switches, about not wanting to serve anymore — in different cities, without ever having met. Zyx calls it a coincidence. Official investigations have never been opened.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FAMOUS CASES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The most famous is [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lullaby[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a nurse who "put to sleep" 31 patients in Ferox in 2071. Others are famous for the opposite reason: more than once the dreamwalker shot by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white] was someone inconvenient — a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white] journalist, a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Church of Reality[/color][/url][color=white] pastor, a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] engineer. The Squad always presents a medical report.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE CLINIC[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Dreamwalkers captured alive are taken to a "recovery clinic" inside the walls of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white], where no relative can enter. No patient has ever come out. Since the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white] was announced, one question is asked everywhere: if the whole country is connected to one Psychoverse, how many will break — and who will have the guns to hold them?[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=The Anchor’s lists][color=white]Neon Wire believes, and the Bubblepedia cannot confirm, that some of the "dreamwalkers" shot by the Anchor Squad were people who remembered the Night of Voices after the Recall Clinic failed to erase it.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]TWO NAMES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white] call it [/color][color=white][b]Xunaya[/b][/color][color=white], "where we meet". [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white]’s lab files, and the streets that learned from them, call it [/color][color=white][b]Dreamthorn[/b][/color][color=white]. The difference between the two names is the whole story of Los Vales.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SACRED TEA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]On sacred nights, the elders of the Xinko-Xenko brewed a tea from the pale flower of a desert cactus, and the whole village fell asleep — and dreamed [/color][color=white][i]the same dream[/i][/color][color=white]. The travelers who crossed the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] in the 1880s called it superstition. For the Xinko it was the opposite of an escape: a way for the whole people to meet in one place, and come back together.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE THEFT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In the 1990s two young chemists, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF]Zachary and Xavyer[/color][/url][color=white], spent years watching the rituals and left with samples of the flower and one question. It took them more than twenty years to answer it. In 2023 Zyx reproduced the Xunaya in a laboratory as [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF][b]Eferverso[/b][/color][/url][color=white], the first [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] drug. Every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] sold in Los Vales today descends from that flower.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE LAST FIELDS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The last natural fields grow around [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF][b]Koxez-Kaya Nova[/b][/color][/url][color=white], deep in the desert. Zyx has tried to buy them for decades and has never succeeded. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] dried the sacred springs around them; the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white] defends them with plagues. For the young Xinko who join the Black Seed, Zyx did not invent anything: it stole a sacred dream and turned it into a leash.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]A SAYING[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Among the Xinko there is a saying the Bubblepedia cannot verify but hears often: [/color][color=#FCFE76][i]"A dream you share is a gift. A dream you buy is a debt."[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=The Shared Dream Patent][color=white]In 2024 Zyx patented every compound of the Xunaya. What the patent does not say is that the formula only works at scale with the [/color][color=white][b]living flower[/b][/color][color=white]: the lab copy loses its strength after a few generations and must be refreshed with wild Xunaya. The last wild fields grow around Koxez-Kaya Nova.[/color]

[color=white]That is why Zyx has never stopped trying to buy the Xinko land, why AquaVale "dried the sacred springs" around it — to make the Xinko sell — and why a group of Xinko scientists founded the Black Seed in 2055. Without the flower, there is no Dream Vision.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The deadline][color=white]A report leaked in 2088 and published by Neon Wire puts a number on it: about [/color][color=white][b]3,100 hectares[/b][/color][color=white] of wild Xunaya are left, and the fields lose [/color][color=white][b]9% a year[/b][/color][color=white]. The math ends around 2090. The LVN called the report false. The Cabinet has known the number since 2084 — which is why the Dream Vision was announced in 2088.[/color]

[color=white]Zyx is racing the deadline. The Master Key can put a whole neighborhood to sleep through the W-Net without a dose, but only for a few hours, and not everyone wakes up well. The tests are the "sleep blackouts": buildings that sleep fourteen hours and do not know why.[/color]

[color=white]This is why the Master Key matters more than the flower. A dream sent by signal needs no chemistry at all. Amora AI does not plan to save the Xunaya. It plans to stop needing it.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The copy that does not fade][color=white]In 2061 Zyx made what it had wanted for forty years: a copy of the Xunaya that keeps its strength and needs no living flower. The lab called it [/color][color=white][b]DT-61[/b][/color][color=white], for Dreamthorn 2061. In the trials it worked perfectly, until the volunteers stopped coming back whole. After months of use they began to treat the world as one more Psychoverse. DT-61 did not end the need for the flower. It manufactured Rupture.[/color]

[color=white]Zyx closed the program in 2063 and never published it. But the formula had already left the building. On the street it is sold as [/color][color=white][b]Ghostthorn[/b][/color][color=white], cut into doses that cost a tenth of a real Psychoverse. Neon Wire believes that most dreamwalkers shot since 2065 had Ghostthorn in their blood.[/color][/spoiler]

[background-block=#0b0d16][align=center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Tw2PYKW9/bp-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999873][color=#8FE3FF]Main page[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#8FE3FF]Los Vales[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#8FE3FF]People[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832326][color=#8FE3FF]Companies[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830613][color=#8FE3FF]Mind & Dreams[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#8FE3FF]Nets & Bodies[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#8FE3FF]Groups & Gangs[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#8FE3FF]Wars & World[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#8FE3FF]Daily Life[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832539][color=#8FE3FF]A–Z[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#8FE3FF]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-dividend/article-dividend.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE MONEY THAT HOLDS THE COUNTRY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since 2029 every citizen with a valid Citizen ID receives, every month, a slice of the profits of the ten conglomerates of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white]: the [/color][color=white][b]Dividend[/b][/color][color=white], today about [/color][color=white][b]900 credits[/b][/color][color=white] — the rent of a room in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white], and nothing more. For the elite it is pocket change. For the poor it is less than the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]Debt Fee[/color][/url][color=white] they pay: on paper they lose money every month. Nobody risks losing it anyway.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE PRICE OF A COUNTRY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Dividend was the price of the Free States. In 2029, a year after the Bankruptcy, the Cabinet offered the ruined country a deal: give us the State, and we will give you a share of the profit. People who had lost their savings in the crash cheered it in the streets, and nobody marched for the dead Republic that year. The first Dividend was [/color][color=white][b]300 credits[/b][/color][color=white], and it bought a month of food.[/color]

[color=white]Then it froze. For fifty-one years the Dividend stayed at 300 credits while rent, water and air went up every year. By 2080 it bought four days of food.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE RAISE OF 2081[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2081 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]OmniCredits[/color][/url][color=white] collapsed and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white]’s workers stopped. The Cabinet crushed the strike in three days and made strikes illegal — and in the same week raised the Dividend for the first time in fifty-two years, to 900 credits. The deal was never written down but everyone understood it: the raise was the price of the silence.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]GETTING CUT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A citizen loses the Dividend for three things: falling behind on a debt, being convicted by an Arbitration Court, or stopping work. In the streets they say he "got cut". Getting cut is the most feared punishment in Los Vales — worse than prison, because prison ends.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHY NOBODY LEAVES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Citizen ID belongs to Bastion: a citizen who leaves the country in debt has it cancelled and becomes stateless. And the debt travels. Under the [/color][color=white][b]Collection Convention[/b][/color][color=white] of 2052, the countries that owe the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] — the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white], the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832733][color=#7FDBFF]Southern Market[/color][/url][color=white] and most of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832686][color=#7FDBFF]African Concord[/color][/url][color=white] — collect Valian debtors on their own soil and send them back to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white]. They have their reasons: their own banks hold pieces of that debt, sold abroad as Valian Debt Bonds, and a debtor who runs away is their money running away. Only the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white] never signed. The only way out is over General Holt’s Wall.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FREE TO DO ANYTHING[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]There is no minimum age for drugs, guns, gambling or the sale of votes. What forbids is the contract. Elite schools, gated condos and executive jobs carry [/color][color=white][b]Conduct Clauses[/b][/color][color=white]: a child caught with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Velocitas[/color][/url][color=white] or a gun costs the family its school place, its home or its job. The rich children — "clause kids" — are the most watched in the country. Total freedom is left to those with no contract at all: the children of the free schools of the outskirts, where the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lucky Shot[/color][/url][color=white] Junior machines stand.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=What the Dividend really costs][color=white]The Dividend is paid in credits issued by the Meridian Trust — and the same month it was raised in 2081, the Meridian raised the interest of the national debt by exactly the total cost of the Dividend. The country pays its own allowance, with interest.[/color][/spoiler]

2833652.bb:
[background-block=#0b0d16][align=center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Tw2PYKW9/bp-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999873][color=#8FE3FF]Main page[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#8FE3FF]Los Vales[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#8FE3FF]People[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832326][color=#8FE3FF]Companies[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830613][color=#8FE3FF]Mind & Dreams[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#8FE3FF]Nets & Bodies[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#8FE3FF]Groups & Gangs[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#8FE3FF]Wars & World[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#8FE3FF]Daily Life[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832539][color=#8FE3FF]A–Z[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#8FE3FF]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-old-culture/article-old-culture.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHY IT EXISTS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In a country where [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] sells dreams, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cage Studios[/color][/url][color=white] makes dead actors "act" and every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Valtron[/color][/url][color=white] device carries an ID linked to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white], an old tube TV is the only screen that [/color][color=white][b]nobody watches with you[/b][/color][color=white]. Televisions, radios, cartridge consoles, tapes and paper books made before 2046 carry no Valtron chip: they never appear on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white] and Panoptica never sees them. Films made before the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]Ortega Law[/color][/url][color=white] show faces that still belonged to the actors. Old books and old games were made by people, not by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF]Amora AI[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]LEGAL, BUT IMPOSSIBLE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Nothing about it is forbidden. It is simply impossible: Bastion does not certify the devices, Valtron does not make spare parts and Sentinel refuses to insure them. The market lives on films and games pulled out of the old Net by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Deep Salvage[/color][/url][color=white] divers and sold under the table, on tube TVs repaired in the scrapyards of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white], and on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Ghostline[/color][/url][color=white] cables.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHERE IT LIVES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Garage cinemas[/b][/color][color=white] — old films on a bedsheet in the garages of Ferox and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]La Maria[/color][/url][color=white], plastic chairs, real popcorn; the ticket is paid in food or in stories; the best known is [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835000][color=#7FDBFF]Tape Night[/color][/url][color=white], behind a blue door in Foundry Row. [/color][color=white][b]Rental rooms[/b][/color][color=white] — hidden shelves of tapes and cartridges; return one late and you get a scolding, never a debt. [/color][color=white][b]The [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF][b]Route 69[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] arcades[/b][/color][color=white] — old machines at truck stops, played with metal coins; the children of the outskirts play there instead of entering a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][color=white][b]The Paper Library of La Maria[/b][/color][color=white] — kept by the Xinko, who never trusted [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Net[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][color=white][b]The Old Radio[/b][/color][color=white] — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white] and the other analog stations, the only voices in the country without ads. [/color][color=white][b]The Night of the Signal[/b][/color][color=white] — once a year every old TV in the country tunes to the same pirate channel at the same hour. Nobody knows who broadcasts it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-old-culture/fig-old-culture-3.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AROUND IT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Old Culture shares its people with three other things Valians love: [/color][color=white][b]the First Rain[/b][/color][color=white] — when free rain falls outside the Premium schedule, cities stop and people go out to get wet; [/color][color=white][b]the Dust League[/b][/color][color=white] — football in the dirt fields of Ferox, with no owner, no bets and no deaths; and [/color][color=white][b]the Fair of Forgiveness[/b][/color][color=white] — once a year, in the garage cinemas, families trade and forgive pieces of each other’s debts.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BILL 2089-14[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2088 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] received [/color][color=white][b]Bill 2089-14[/b][/color][color=white], the Device Registration Act. From 2089 every screen, radio and console in the country must carry a Valtron chip or be handed in; an unregistered device becomes a debt, and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] will collect it. Officially it is about fire safety. The tapeheads read it differently: a year before the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white] begins, the Cabinet wants to close the only network the signal cannot reach.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]HOW THE CORPS ANSWER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Zyx launched a Psychoverse called [/color][color=white][b]"Retro"[/b][/color][color=white], which tapeheads despise. Cage Studios sues screenings of films with faces it now owns. Panoptica keeps a list of who attends — "people who unplug, organize". The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] calls the whole thing "poor people’s nostalgia".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=What the signal cannot reach][color=white]The Master Key can put whole neighborhoods to sleep through the W-Net without a dose. It cannot reach a device with no Valtron chip. Without meaning to, the Old Culture built the only network in Los Vales that the Dream Vision cannot touch.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]1. NAME[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The name comes from the Spanish [/color][color=white][i]los valles[/i][/color][color=white], "the valleys", the dry valleys of the old Southwest where the first casino towns were built. In Spanish a [/color][color=white][i]vale[/i][/color][color=white] is also a voucher, a written promise to pay — a meaning Valians rarely forget. The country was the [/color][color=white][b]State of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (2000–2013), the [/color][color=white][b]Republic of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (2013–2028) and, since the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832690][color=#7FDBFF]bankruptcy of 2028[/color][/url][color=white], the [/color][color=white][b]Free States of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white]. "Free" refers to the market, not to the citizens.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]2. NATIONAL SYMBOLS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The symbols of Los Vales were chosen in the dark years of the Thirst, when the country needed something to sell to itself. The [/color][color=white][b]Neon Girl[/b][/color][color=white] of the coat of arms comes from the first neon signs of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white], where she lay above the casino doors in the 1990s; the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] made her official in 2057, together with the motto. The [/color][color=white][b]demon pitaya[/b][/color][color=white], the red star of the old flags, is the national fruit — it has been blue since [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]ALCHACAL[/color][/url][color=white] changed its colour, and nobody changed the flag. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2522105][color=#7FDBFF]Historical flags →[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]3. HISTORY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999865][color=#7FDBFF][i]History of Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834986][color=#7FDBFF][i]Bubblepedia: Who Owns Whom[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]In less than a century Los Vales went from an empty desert of the old American West to the richest country on Earth: a corporate state (2000), a republic won with forgotten nuclear warheads (2013), a bankrupt republic handed to its creditors (2028), and the Free States of the corporations ever since.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Before the state (to 1995)[/b][/color]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] desert was the land of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white], who formed a confederation in 1881 with its capital at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya[/color][/url][color=white] and guarded the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]Xunaya[/color][/url][color=white], a cactus flower whose tea let a whole village share one dream. The industrial East, ruled since the 19th century by the doctrine of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF]Edward Whitmore[/color][/url][color=white] and by railroad and arms giants such as the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF]Blackstones[/color][/url][color=white], left the West empty.[/color]

[color=white]After 1945 the United States used it to test atomic weapons. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] opened in 1976, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]Kobe Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] founded the tax-free town of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white] in 1985 and Las Noites became the first casino city in 1990. When [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NAV[/color][/url][color=white] collapsed, the Blackstones kept its arms division as [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white] and its bank as the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The State of Desires (1999–2012)[/b][/color]

[color=white]In 1999 the chemists [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF]Zachary and Xavyer[/color][/url][color=white] founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] in a basement of Las Noites, and the security firm [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] cleared Hermosa of gangs. In 2000 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white] united [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Coronnel[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Tampa[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Sonora[/color][/url][color=white] into the State of Los Vales, ruled by a Governor-General. Private armies fought the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]First Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white] (2001–2006), and in 2007 Koxez-Kaya was annexed and renamed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]La Marijuana[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The Republic (2013–2028)[/b][/color]

[color=white]When a military coup broke the United States in 2012, Los Vales declared independence; WM, holding the forgotten warheads of Coronnel, defeated the American army in 2013. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Manuella Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] led the Republic until she lost the 2014 election to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Menphis Polo[/color][/url][color=white] — the only contested election in the country's history.[/color]

[color=white]In 2022 a warhead exploded on top of the WM tower and erased Hermosa, the capital, with almost two million people. Zyx offered the survivors [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Eferverso[/color][/url][color=white], the first [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] drug. The Republic, unable to pay for the ruins, went bankrupt in 2028 and the Corporate Cabinet took full power.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The Free States (2028–2073)[/b][/color]

[color=white]Zyx won the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Reality War[/color][/url][color=white] of 2030 and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] sold the opposite promise — a body that never fails. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832736][color=#7FDBFF]Urban Monopolization[/color][/url][color=white] (2030–2050) reduced the country to seven cities. The robots of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] rebelled in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Droid War[/color][/url][color=white] (2044), the internet was rebuilt behind [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Seal[/color][/url][color=white], and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white] invaded in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]Reunification War[/color][/url][color=white] (2049); the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF]Rebirth Plan[/color][/url][color=white] of 2050, paid largely by Zyx, rebuilt the country.[/color]

[color=white]Between 2050 and 2079 the twenty corporations of the Cabinet merged into ten conglomerates. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]The Thirst[/color][/url][color=white] (2055–2064) and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF]World War III[/color][/url][color=white] (2067–2073), in which Los Vales stayed neutral and sold to every side, made it the richest country on Earth.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The present (2073–2088)[/b][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Total Connection[/color][/url][color=white] (2073) made reality drugs a free social benefit; [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF]Amora AI[/color][/url][color=white], an artificial intelligence, became CEO of Zyx in 2074. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]Night of Voices[/color][/url][color=white] (2076), the raise of the Dividend (2081), the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]Great Collection[/color][/url][color=white] (2083) and the resignation of President Monteiro (2084) followed. In 2088 President Valmont and Amora AI announced the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF][b]Dream Vision[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a single national dream for every citizen.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]
