[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]4. GEOGRAPHY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF][i]Map of Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF][i]The Droughts[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]Los Vales lies on the Pacific coast of the former American West, from the industrial north of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Buffalo[/color][/url][color=white] to the mountains of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Fortuna[/color][/url][color=white]. Its interior is the [/color][color=white][b]Escaldar[/b][/color][color=white], a hot desert holding the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] aquifers, the old [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay[/color][/url][color=white] oil fields, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] labor camps and, at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya Nova[/color][/url][color=white], the last wild fields of Xunaya. A single highway, [/color][color=white][b]Route 69[/b][/color][color=white], links all seven cities; off the road there are almost no towns left.[/color]

[color=white][b]Climate.[/b][/color][color=white] Arid and getting worse. The last natural river, the Rio Colorado Novo, ran dry during the Thirst (2055–2064); rain returned only when AquaVale began seeding the clouds, and since 2085 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]seeded rain[/color][/url][color=white] has been failing again (the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]Dry Drought[/color][/url][color=white]). [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] lives under permanent smog. Water is sold by the liter.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The coast[/b][/color]

[color=white]The sea is as owned as the land. The Pacific trade lane leaves the Port of Ferox for the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white]. Offshore stand BeDay's sea launch platform and the Zyx Floating Lab, where nobody may dock; off Tampa lies Lockwell Island, the prison for debtors who tried to run. The rusting [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Dinoco[/color][/url][color=white] Platform still stands where it exploded in 2006, and beyond [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white] stretches the [/color][color=white][b]Dead Zone[/b][/color][color=white], a toxic tide without fish since 2055.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Route 69[/b][/color]

[color=white]The spine of the country, from the port of Ferox to the southern border. Bombed into a chain of craters in 2049, rebuilt by the Rebirth Plan, it is run today by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Trans Vales[/color][/url][color=white] with a toll every 50 km and shared by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Coyote Cabs[/color][/url][color=white], AquaVale water convoys, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Pizza 69[/color][/url][color=white] drones and, once a year, the illegal [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69 Race[/color][/url][color=white]. In 2058 the empty aquifers swallowed 120 km of it.[/color]

Sonora, where Hermosa stood, is governed as the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white] Autonomous Region. [size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]6. GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF][i]Corporate Cabinet[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF][i]Corporate Charter[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF][i]Leaders of Los Vales[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]Los Vales is a [/color][color=white][b]corporocracy[/b][/color][color=white]. Since 2028 power belongs to the [/color][color=white][b]Corporate Cabinet[/b][/color][color=white], where ten conglomerates hold 42 votes; 22 make a majority. The Cabinet chooses the President, who represents it and does not govern it. There are no parties and no elections. The law of the country is the [/color][color=white][b]Corporate Charter[/b][/color][color=white], amended 311 times; disputes go to the paid [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]Arbitration Courts[/color][/url][color=white], and order in the streets is kept by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white] and by private security.[/color]

[color=white]Almost everything is legal at any age — drugs, guns, gambling, selling a vote or a face. What restricts Valians is not the law but the contract: elite schools, gated condos and executive jobs carry [/color][color=white][b]Conduct Clauses[/b][/color][color=white], and losing one can cost a family its home.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]8. MILITARY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]There is no national army. Defense is contracted to [/color][color=white][b]WM-Automa[/b][/color][color=white] — the WM army and Automa's robot divisions — and the state owns no weapon it did not rent. The country's nuclear capacity dates from the warheads of Coronnel found in 2013. Inside the cities, armed rescue is sold by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Halo Response[/color][/url][color=white] and street patrols by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Vigilantes[/color][/url][color=white] of Ferox.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]9. ECONOMY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832658][color=#7FDBFF][i]Economy of Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF][i]Money and Debt[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833648][color=#7FDBFF][i]The Dividend[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]Los Vales is the richest country in the world and the most indebted people. It exports metal from space, robots, weapons, implants, films and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverses[/color][/url][color=white], and imports little but grain and chips. Every public service is a subscription; the State itself still pays the debt of 2028 through the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]Debt Fee[/color][/url][color=white] on every bill. The average household owes [/color][color=white][b]61,000 credits[/b][/color][color=white], and debts are inherited.[/color]

[color=white]The national money is the [/color][color=white][b]credit[/b][/color][color=white] (CR), issued by the Meridian Trust; NightCoin circulates in Las Noites and OmniCredit inside [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white]. Since 2029 every citizen with a valid Citizen ID receives the [/color][color=white][b]Dividend[/b][/color][color=white], today about 900 CR a month from the profits of the ten conglomerates — and losing it is the most feared punishment in the country.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]10. INFRASTRUCTURE AND TECHNOLOGY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Port of Ferox and the Ferox Spaceport carry almost all foreign trade. After the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white] corrupted the internet in 2044, the country rebuilt its networks: the watched [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF][b]W-Net[/b][/color][/url][color=white] of Bastion, the private [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF][b]C-Nets[/b][/color][/url][color=white], and the old Net sealed behind the [/color][color=white][b]Seal[/b][/color][color=white], guarded by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cerberus[/color][/url][color=white]. Technology pulls the population two ways: the Psychoverses of Zyx, worlds entered through drugs, and the implants of Kizuna, up to the fully artificial bodies of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Converts[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]The Nets →[/color][/url][color=white] · [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]The Psychoverses →[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]11. DEMOGRAPHICS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF][i]Events & Life[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF][i]Growing Up in Los Vales[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]About [/color][color=white][b]233 million[/b][/color][color=white] people live in Los Vales, almost all of them in the seven metropolises. The country grew through immigration: Americans fleeing the East, Latin Americans through the casino towns, Japanese settlers in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama State[/color][/url][color=white] in the 2000s and, since 2083, refugees at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]the Wall[/color][/url][color=white], many of whom end up in Lockwell's camps. The Xinko-Xenko are the only indigenous people; fewer than ever, they live deep in the Escaldar.[/color]

[color=white]The deepest division is not ethnic but mental: the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Connected[/b][/color][/url][color=white] live mostly inside a Psychoverse, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Awake[/b][/color][/url][color=white] never entered or managed to leave, the [/color][color=white][b]Converts[/b][/color][color=white] live in artificial bodies and cannot dream. Since the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate Name Law[/color][/url][color=white] of 2059, many children carry brand names in exchange for food and school. The homicide counter of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] rarely shows fewer than 1,800 deaths a day.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Religion[/b][/color]

[color=white]Most Valians declare none. The largest movement is the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF][b]Church of Reality[/b][/color][/url][color=white], which preaches waking up and fills the squares since the Dream Vision; the Xinko-Xenko keep their shared-dream rites; Zyx's own advertising is often described as a faith. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]The Church of Reality →[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Languages[/b][/color]

[color=white]English is the language of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]the Charter[/color][/url][color=white] and of business. Spanish is spoken everywhere south of Las Noites, Japanese in the Nakama State, and Xinko only in the desert. The street mixes all of them with brand names. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833653][color=#7FDBFF]Street Talk →[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-los-vales/fig-los-vales-11.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]12. DAILY LIFE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF][i]Growing Up in Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832658][color=#7FDBFF][i]Economy of Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999871][color=#7FDBFF][i]Dangers[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]A day in Los Vales is a chain of payments. The water is bought by the liter, the air by the hour in Ferox, the ambulance by subscription and the school by contract. Most Valians eat cheap, drink something with a stimulant in it, work long shifts for a conglomerate and spend the night inside a Psychoverse. The rich live behind walls where food is grown in soil and nobody checks a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]Life Score[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Food and drink[/b][/color]

[color=white]Since the crisis of 2055 most of what Valians eat is grown in a lab, a greenhouse or a cricket farm. Real food — meat, fruit and vegetables grown in soil — is a luxury of the walled districts.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]


[table]

[tr][td][color=#DDDDDD]Demon pitaya[/color][/td][td][color=#DDDDDD]Verdana greenhouses[/color][/td][td][color=#DDDDDD]The national fruit. Turned blue by ALCHACAL[/color][/td][/tr]

[tr][td][color=#DDDDDD]Water[/color][/td][td][color=#DDDDDD]AquaVale[/color][/td][td][color=#DDDDDD]1 to 3 CR per liter; the wells of La Maria are the last free ones[/color][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]School and work[/b][/color]

[color=white]There are almost no public schools. At twelve, children sign twenty-year contracts with the OmniMart Academy, the Automa Institute or the Kizuna School in exchange for study, food and a guaranteed job; breaking the contract means starting adult life in debt to Lockwell. Elite schools carry [/color][color=white][b]Conduct Clauses[/b][/color][color=white]; the free schools of the outskirts carry nothing — "free" meaning unprotected. Shifts of twelve hours are normal, and part of many wages is paid in company money.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Health[/b][/color]

[color=white]Every Valian has a [/color][color=white][b]Life Score[/b][/color][color=white] from 0 to 1,000, calculated by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Asclepius[/color][/url][color=white], that sets the price of insurance, rescue, water, rent and credit. Rescue is sold by Halo Response — Halo Silver costs 39 CR a month — and Halo ambulances do not stop for people without a plan. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]Fresh Air Co[/color][/url][color=white] sells breathable air in Ferox, where respiratory disease is the leading cause of death.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Getting around[/b][/color]

[color=white]Route 69 is the only road between the cities, with a Trans Vales toll every 50 km. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white] has automated trains; the other cities have Coyote Cabs, which check your balance before you get in. In Ferox the workers sleep between shifts in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]RestBox[/color][/url][color=white] capsules, at 4 CR an hour.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]Free time[/b][/color]

[color=white]Valians watch [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]TOTAL[/color][/url][color=white] Football and bet on it, play the casinos under the Dome of Las Noites, live films from the inside with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Cinemaphica[/color][/url][color=white] and spend whole nights in the Psychoverses of Zyx. The young of the outskirts collect the Old Culture — old televisions, video games, radios and paper books — and the illegal Route 69 Race is watched by millions once a year.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]13. CULTURE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999867][color=#7FDBFF][i]Entertainment[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833652][color=#7FDBFF][i]The Old Culture[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833653][color=#7FDBFF][i]Street Talk[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]Valian culture is mostly sold: the films of Valewood and their digital actors with bought faces, the TOTAL football league, the casinos of Las Noites, the feeds of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832642][color=#7FDBFF]Bubblechat[/color][/url][color=white] and the pirate broadcasts of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white]. Against all of it the young of the outskirts collect the [/color][color=white][b]Old Culture[/b][/color][color=white] — old televisions, video games, radios, films and paper books that work without a subscription. The usual goodbye is "[/color][color=white][b]Stay up[/b][/color][color=white]."[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHAT THE SCHOOL BOOKS LEAVE OUT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Night of Voices of 2076 was not a technical failure: for nine hours the screens showed a recording of the Dream Vision test of 2075, with volunteers who never woke up. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF]Recall Clinic[/color][/url][color=white] opened in 2082, with Cerberus money, to erase that night from the people who saw it.[/color]

[color=white]And the Cabinet is not what it seems: OmniMart, Vale Holdings and WM-Automa — 14 votes — are run by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF]Eterna[/color][/url][color=white] copies of dead executives, on servers owned by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AboveAll[/color][/url][color=white]. Add the 6 votes of Zyx, which AboveAll owns, and it commands 20 of the 22 votes needed for a majority.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]THE GENETIC RELIEF PROGRAM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Heirs can erase half of an inherited balance with a single cheek swab. The sample is analyzed by our partners at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Genesis Bio[/color][/url][color=white] for research that will one day benefit every Valian. The swab is painless. The research is confidential. The other half of the balance remains.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]When does my debt expire?[/b][/color][color=white] It does not.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I declare bankruptcy?[/b][/color][color=white] Only the Republic ever did, in 2028. It became the Free States.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I refuse an inheritance?[/b][/color][color=white] You can refuse the house. You cannot refuse the debt.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who bought my debt?[/b][/color][color=white] Check your notices. The name at the top changes; the number does not.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"A debt is the only thing in Los Vales that lives forever. We just make sure it is looked after." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][i]Lockwell[/i][/color][/url]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Every Saturday, in a garage behind a blue door, we put an old film on a tube TV and watch it together. The TV has no chip, the tape has no owner, and nobody is counting who came. It is the only screen in Los Vales that does not watch you back.[/color]

[color=white]There is no ticket. Bring food for the table, or a story for after the film. Children come free and leave last.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]NOTICE · BILL 2089-14[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] wants every TV in the country to carry a chip by next year. Ours will not. If [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] knocks on the blue door, the tapes go out the back and the TVs stay. Tapes can be hidden. Saturdays cannot be banned. See you this week.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F2B95B][b]HOUSE RULES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]1.[/b][/color][color=white] Cover your Lens, or sit in the back row. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white] keeps a list of "people who unplug". We do not want to be on it.[/color]

[color=white][b]2.[/b][/color][color=white] No [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Velocitas[/color][/url][color=white], no doses, no [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] headsets. Tonight you are here.[/color]

[color=white][b]3.[/b][/color][color=white] Talk during the boring parts. That is what the boring parts are for.[/color]

[color=white][b]4.[/b][/color][color=white] If someone you do not know asks for the address, say you only came for the popcorn.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Stay up." — written in chalk on the inside of the blue door[/i][/color]

[align=center][b][background=#F5C542][color=#0b1120] Buy a piece [/color][/background][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835003][color=#F5C542]The Wall[/color][/url][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#F5C542]The Charter[/color][/url][color=#F5C542] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#F5C542]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]THE CLAUSE NOBODY READ ALOUD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2028 the Republic of Los Vales could not pay its debts, and its creditors took the country instead. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Debt Accord[/color][/url][color=white] they signed has a clause that was never read aloud: if the debt of 2028 is ever paid in full, the Free States are dissolved and the Republic of 2013 returns — with its president, its courts and its elections.[/color]

[color=white]In 2086 a photo of that page reached [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white]. The next morning, a dockworker in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] taped a coin to a wall and wrote under it: "My piece." That was the beginning.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]WHO OWNS YOUR DEBT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The debt of 2028 is not in a vault in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white]. The Meridian sold it in pieces, as Valian Debt Bonds, to funds in Osaka, Lagos and Zurich. Every credit you give here buys back a piece from someone who has never seen Los Vales.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-5.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-6.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clause-zero-7.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F5C542][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]How big is the debt?[/b][/color][color=white] 612 billion credits in 2028. With sixty years of interest, nobody will tell us the number. We estimate thirty-eight trillion.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why does the counter go down?[/b][/color][color=white] Every time we get close, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] raises the interest. We raise the goal the same afternoon.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is it legal?[/b][/color][color=white] Paying a debt is always legal. That is the one thing in this country nobody can forbid.[/color]

[color=white][b]What if we never finish?[/b][/color][color=white] Then we will have found out what the debt was for.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Every nation has a price." — Meridian Trust, notice of interest adjustment, November 2088[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/clause-zero/clausezero-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

[align=center][b][background=#8FC7FF][color=#0c1220] Our dreams [/color][/background][color=#8FC7FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2513519][color=#8FC7FF]The real thing[/color][/url][color=#8FC7FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#8FC7FF]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Not every Valian can pay nine credits for a night in Jackpot Eternal. Somnia is the dream for everyone else: simple, short and always the same, sold in every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white] for one credit. You will not fly. You will not be a hero. You will rest, somewhere a little better than where you are.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-4.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FC7FF][b]COMING IN 2089[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Somnia Home Sleep: a whole night, every night, in your own bed, with a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]NutriCube[/color][/url][color=white] drip for the morning. Part of the national program. Ask at your OmniMart.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-6.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-7.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FC7FF][b]WHAT YOU WILL NOT DREAM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Somnia dreams are fixed. You cannot choose who is there, you cannot change the ending and you cannot stay longer than the dose. If you want more, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx Experience[/color][/url][color=white] is one aisle over.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FC7FF][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is Somnia the same as [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zyx[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] Somnia is made under license from Zyx, with Zyx compounds, on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]ZyxNet[/color][/url][color=white]. It is completely different.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why is it so cheap?[/b][/color][color=white] Because there are so many of you.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I get used to it?[/b][/color][color=white] Most of our customers buy the month of nights.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is it free since the [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Total Connection[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] The basic [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] of your city is free. Somnia is cheaper than free: it is faster.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Rest is the only luxury everyone can afford. We made it cost one credit." — Somnia[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-contract-class/article-contract-class.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE PEOPLE IN THE MIDDLE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Between the elite inside the walls and the poor outside them lives the [/color][color=white][b]contract class[/b][/color][color=white]: about one Valian in seven, the people with a corporate contract. Engineers at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white], clerks at the Meridian, nurses at Halo, managers at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white]. They live in company flats, ride the company bus, send their children to the company school and get sick under the company plan. Their streets are clean, their water runs and their rain comes on schedule.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]A GOOD LIFE, ON LOAN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Everything they have belongs to the contract. The flat, the school place, the health plan and often the implants come with the job and leave with it. A contract worker who is fired, stays ill too long or signs the wrong petition loses all of it on the same day: out of the flat in the morning, in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white]’s files by night. That is why the contract class is the most obedient class in Los Vales. It has the most to lose.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]LANYARDS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In the outskirts they are called [/color][color=white][b]lanyards[/b][/color][color=white], after the company badge they never take off. The poor envy them and despise them in the same breath. The elite barely see them. The lanyards themselves say little: their contracts carry Conduct Clauses, and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white] reads the company chats.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHY THE CABINET NEEDS THEM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The contract class runs the machines the companies own and buys what the poor cannot afford: the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna Lens[/color][/url][color=white] upgrades, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] subscriptions, the weekend under the Dome. Above all, it shows everyone else that the system works for those who obey. Every company district has a window that faces the outskirts. It is not an accident.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-why-invade/article-why-invade.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]A SMALL COUNTRY, A HUNGRY WORLD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Los Vales has seven cities, no national army and neighbors who are starving. Every year someone asks why nobody takes it. The answer is not in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]the Charter[/color][/url][color=white]. It is in the bank statements of the rest of the world.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]EVERYONE OWNS A PIECE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Los Vales is less a country than a free zone, and the world already profits from it. The shareholders of the ten conglomerates live in Osaka, Lagos, Singapore and Zurich. Pension funds abroad hold Valian Debt Bonds. The factories of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white] run on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay[/color][/url][color=white] metal. To invade Los Vales would be to bomb your own investments, and the people who own them would not allow it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE ONES WHO TRIED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white] is the exception: it owns nothing in Los Vales and has nothing to lose there. It tried in 2013 and lost to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white]. It tried again in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF][b]Reunification War[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] of 2049[/b][/color][color=white] and lost again, to WM armor, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] droids and an army of contractors paid by the hour. Since then it has built a wall to keep its own people in.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHAT NOBODY CONFIRMS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Two things keep the generals of the world awake, and neither has ever been confirmed. The first is the bomb. WM once held the only nuclear arsenal of the West, and in 2022 the world learned that it had never been dismantled. Nobody knows what is left of it.[/color]

[color=white]The second is the sky. BeDay Astral has a station and a fleet in orbit, and a load of space metal dropped from orbit hits like a missile that no radar was built to stop. BeDay calls this "a misunderstanding of physics". Nobody laughs.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]
